drops: nothing; a derived position is recorded rather than discarded, because interpolation is legitimate and only its promotion to observation is not
forbidden_inferences: an interpolated, propagated or simulated position -> an observation a source made
a derived position being wrong later -> the observations under it being wrong; the fixes are append-only and the derivation is what gets recomputed
a fast-moving projection -> history being written at that rate
invalidates_on: any observation named in derived_from is published or retracted (reheat)
preserves: the observation mode on every position and the references from a derived position back to the fixes it was computed from

drops: domain keying entirely; a facet is the intersection of a phenotype the occurrence carries, a relation the protocol offers, and that relation being meaningful for that phenotype
forbidden_inferences: a candidate facet -> a compiled contract, an enactment, closed obligations, or an authorized effect
a protocol appearing in a facet -> that protocol being reachable, admitted or lawful on this subject for this actor
an affordance describing how a source is reached -> a phenotype; that mapping was measured turning an earthquake feed into an identity credential and a commerce protocol then offered it IDENTIFY
invalidates_on: the corpus is regenerated, or the declared vocabulary changes
preserves: the law's finite relation vocabulary and its five-state ladder, enforced rather than cited: the compiler's vocabularies are compared against the CUE declaration and every facet it emits claims the first rung only

drops: the promoter's ability to decide anything: it constructs a contract shape, hands it to bf_protocol_derivation_register, and reports what came back
forbidden_inferences: a compiled contract -> an enacted request, closed obligations, or an authorized effect
a compiled contract -> conformance to the standard its name mentions; the name is derived from the protocol and the relation and claims nothing about that protocol's specification
a promoter constructing a contract shape -> that shape being right for the relation; three roles is lawful and is not what COMMAND or SETTLE need
a receipt for one occurrence -> evidence for another; a contract may not borrow an observation
invalidates_on: the receipted body stops hashing to its receipt, or the corpus is regenerated
preserves: the facet's relation and phenotype, the ForeignTwin receipt digest under it, and the program count the native ProtocolContract owner returned when it registered the contract

drops: the silent third option; storing an unknown key where nothing looks at it discarded 77 cannot_infer lines and 272 more, while the loss report went on saying those architectures had stated nothing
forbidden_inferences: a reported undeclared key -> a wrong key; the fix is either a rule or a rename and the registry cannot tell which
no undeclared keys -> a complete registry; it means every key written has a reader
invalidates_on: a yaff file introduces a key no renderer reads
preserves: every field key an author wrote, either as something a renderer reads or as something the registry names as unread

drops: nothing the source said; keeping only this estate's digest lost every statement the publisher made, including the only machine-readable statement of rights a source ever makes
forbidden_inferences: a source-supplied digest matching ours -> the source being right; the bytes agree and nothing follows about the content
robots permitting a read -> a licence to republish; an absent license link means the source stated none, not that permission exists
an RFC 9421 signature verifying -> factual correctness or reuse permission
a 304 -> the thing not having changed in the world; the representation this estate holds is still current, which is a different claim
invalidates_on: the source is re-observed and returns a different validator or digest
preserves: both independent sets of facts about one representation: this estate's digest of the bytes it retained, and the source's own ETag, Last-Modified, Content-Type, Content-Location, Link rel=license and rel=canonical, RFC 9530 Content-Digest and Repr-Digest, and whether an RFC 9421 signature was present

drops: every feature the mapping cannot place honestly -- no source instant, a geometry this owner cannot place exactly, no subject key, or a source instant later than the moment of ingest -- each refused and counted separately rather than dropped quietly
forbidden_inferences: a feature carrying no instant -> an observation at the moment of ingest; a stamped feature is indistinguishable from a real one forever afterwards, so it is refused instead
an ingested position -> an admitted, disclosable or authoritative one; intake records what a source said and settles nothing about whether it may be repeated
observing one document twice -> two observations; ingest is idempotent by the whole source digest
an empty ingest -> a source that reported nothing; an unparseable document fails rather than recording an absence
invalidates_on: the source is re-observed and a new receipt with a different digest arrives (reheat)
preserves: the source's own instant, the occurrence and digest that identify the document observed, and the subject key the source published, under a mapping declared per source rather than inferred from the payload

drops: the assumption that the identifier a source currently prefers is the identity; the lineage decides the subject and the label does not

a changed preferred identifier -> a new thing; USGS states that its preferred event id can change while the associated identifiers persist, and treating the new label as a new subject splits one earthquake in two
an alias resolving -> authority over either identifier's namespace
invalidates_on: a source declares a different identifier association for the same subject (reheat)
preserves: every identifier a source declared together, the subject they resolve to, and when each was first and last seen

owners.domain: Surface / Account World composition / radio and podcasts
forbidden_inferences: a programme row or schedule -> a broadcast licence, a performing-rights clearance, a live stream that is actually up, or territorial availability

a feed item -> that a directory has accepted the feed, that the enclosure length is known (length is 0), or that the episode was streamed anywhere; presence of a MediaProgram or of this owner never implies a published podcast
a confirmed track -> licence to play that track; tracklists are metadata only
a reviewed transcript -> machine transcription accuracy; review is the owner's own mark, and no transcription engine runs here
internal_calculi: Additions to the AccountWorldBinding owner (account-world-audio-1 tables created by awa_initialize): one programme row per space (station or show, IANA time zone, language, author, category, explicit flag, optional live-stream piece reference), up to 48 weekly slots (ISO weekday, start minute, length, programme, host, optional piece or sibling-space link), episode details keyed by an item reference the space already holds (season, number, ISO date), and up to 600 time marks per episode (track, chapter, cue, clip, person, source) with start and end milliseconds and a checked flag meaning a confirmed track or a reviewed cue or clip. Each table keeps a draft copy and a released copy; triggers on account_world_release copy the drafts inside the release transaction and drop the released copy on withdrawal. Every owner write rechecks the binding and draft World and advances the exact space revision in one immediate transaction.
invariants: Recordings and the live stream are always "<source>/<24 hex key>" references; a mark link is an https citation or profile address or a piece reference and is never played; no media URL, rights statement, listener count or availability claim is stored.

Audio plays (preload none, no autoplay) and enters the RSS feed as an enclosure only when the piece's own source, re-read on that request, states public domain, CC0, CC BY or CC BY-SA and gives an https file; otherwise the page links to where it is published and the feed leaves the episode out. a publication creates a presence projection while retaining its source presence and semantic identity
a web alias may redirect only to an address of the same semantic subject
a registered host supplies public context but never grants subject, institution, effect, or private-closure authority
a public URL aperture prepares only a reviewed Studio route on a configured host; it never observes, claims, fetches, or promotes a ForeignTwin

institution kinds and subject kinds are extensible domain grammar, not a generic ERP ontology

a closure owner-reference is admitted only for an already-active exact Presence, names its independent owner, exact representation, digest and receipt, and cannot create a subject, Presence, disclosure, owner state, lifecycle, or authority
a profile's self view is selected by the verified session alone; no path, query, or header can select it
a client registered through MCP and through HTTP resolves to one entity in one store
a foreign twin excluded by robots is receipted without its source URL being fetched
completing a WorkGraph node requires the lease token issued at claim; a valid-hex wrong token is refused by the queue as stale_claim
a presence is bound once; the core refuses a re-bind, and a move is not emulated by delete and reinsert
a standing address stands only on an already-bound address
a web alias may bind only between two addresses of the same semantic subject
a workgraph failure carries a class from the scheduler's closed set, which decides retryability
a protocol projection is a carrier grammar over one semantic Matrix; it never becomes a second owner of the data
a capability quoted to an agent carries the same price the financial membrane reports; there is no second price list
an unverified payment is never treated as settled; with no facilitator the resource answers 402 and says why

a cross-carrier capability exchange uses one native ProtocolMachine identity; quote and payment presentation may be retained, while payment verification and execution remain impossible without an exercised rail-specific adapter
a protocol field the source does not carry is emitted null with a stated reason, never fabricated
a content type describes its own fields; an editor generates its form from that description and holds no second copy of any schema
the notes index lists only pages that are published AND guest-readable, so it can never advertise a page a reader cannot open
an asset or theme is a ForeignTwin: admitted through the same observe right, robots preflight, receipt and content digest as any other foreign observation
a retained asset body is served only while it still hashes to its receipt; a digest mismatch is refused, not served
binding an asset to an account is an edge in the identity graph, which is what makes a shared cache of external things one account's expression
a session is authenticated and separately authorized; being signed in is never authority to mutate
a room describes its subject and is never a second way into it; readability is decided once, by the rule the reader path uses, so no surface can serve a body another surface refuses
a queue of unpublished things discloses its count and never its rows to a viewer who cannot act on them; the count is a fact about the institution, the rows are content nobody has published
an operational surface carries a no-index directive and is named in robots.txt, because a surface reachable by a person is reachable by a crawler that followed the same link
the machine web is materialized, not generated per caller: a sitemap, a feed and a metadata block are the same bytes for every consumer, so ten thousand machine reads cost what one costs
a sitemap is a publication claim and carries only what the reader path would serve to a stranger; an unpublished thing listed there is one more way to leak it
an advertised alternate representation exists at the address it advertises; a rel=alternate promising JSON that returns HTML is a false statement about the surface
a machine consumer is offered a validator and answered 304 when it already holds the bytes, and HEAD is a first-class verb because it is how freshness is checked without paying for a body
a carrier projection never becomes a second owner of facts; a preview card, a sitemap entry and a payment quote are all projections of one state and cannot disagree with it or each other
a subject stands at explicit per-representation addresses as well as under content negotiation, because many machine consumers follow links and never send an Accept header
a manifest names every representation of a subject so one fetch discovers the family, and digests the representation rather than asserting a version of the subject
absent geometry is published as null with the reason; the observed roll gives an address and synthesising a centroid would turn a missing fact into a plausible one
machine readership is measured from the access log rather than assumed; a declared user agent is counted as a claim about purpose and never treated as identity or as a basis for access
a foreign source is read through the cheapest deterministic representation it already publishes; HTML extraction and model interpretation are the last two rungs of a ladder, never the first move

discovery decides what to read and never becomes a second way to read it; every body that matters is admitted by the organ that owns foreign observation, so a parser works from bytes that still hash to their receipt

a probe verifies the representation is present, not that the server answered 200; a rejection page served with a success code otherwise records an affordance the source does not have and routes every later read into a carrier that will never answer
a source that declares nothing machine-legible is recorded as expensive rather than treated as normal; the cost of reading it is a property of that source and belongs in its passport
a push delivery is a notification and never content; the payload says a topic moved, and the bytes retained are the ones the origin serves on a re-read under the admission law
a hub's verification is refused unless the topic it names is exactly the topic that callback subscribed to; without that check a stranger enrols this institution into a subject it never chose
a subscription created with a secret refuses an unsigned delivery, and compares the signature in constant time; an early return leaks the digest one byte at a time
a notification triggers at most one re-read per minute per subscription, so a flood of pings cannot turn a callback into an amplifier aimed at the publisher
work provoked by a request happens after the reply and off the request path; a single-threaded organ that fetches inline can deadlock against itself when the topic it reads is one it serves
a receipted body is parsed only while it still hashes to its receipt; bytes that have drifted are not the bytes that were observed and cannot support any claim derived from them
a parsed foreign item is a candidate carrying its own provenance, recorded as what a source declared at an observed time, never as what is true or current or will occur
a subscription lease is renewed inside its own window; a lapsed lease is silent rather than loud, and a topic that stops delivering is indistinguishable from a source with no news
a WebSub renewal retains the subscription callback/token identity; parallel rows would multiply foreign rereads and make one source appear as several independent observations
a verified WebSub delivery writes only a coalesced SourceDirty notification; a bounded worker performs the later ForeignTwin reread, so repeated notifications normally produce one observation attempt
a callback without the receipt that authorized its subscription cannot induce a foreign read; notification reachability is not observe authority
an address withdrawn from a source index is recorded as a withdrawal; a claim loses its support when its source stops listing it, and every copy never told keeps asserting it
a source index is read where the source says it lives, not at a conventional path; a site may answer the conventional address with an unrelated document and a success code
a refusal by the observation law is reported as the refusal it is, never as a generic failure; a source whose robots cannot be reached is declined correctly rather than unavailable accidentally

a challenge page is recorded as the source declining machine reading and is not circumvented; a source may advertise an affordance in one document and gate it in another, and that contradiction is a fact about the source
session scope follows the account tier at login; a free account reads, a paid tier may also write

a client-institution hostname is a private AuthorityGraph aperture: every request requires an active exact institution grant, with read for GET/HEAD and write/admin for a mutation, before any legacy upstream is contacted; generic subscription tier or Bonfyre write scope never substitutes for the client grant

a client grant is re-evaluated on each request, so revocation or expiry denies an otherwise valid session immediately; it is a transport admission aperture and does not replace the managed product's object-level authority
a mutation reaching the CMS through nginx is held to write scope, because an auth subrequest is always a GET and cannot see the original verb
a person-facing surface is a flow: each step renders the next and carries its subject forward, rather than a panel of controls that each fire one call
the operator surface states what is open for decision, computed from the stores that hold it, and gives each open thing the one act that closes it
a queue count is counted, never inferred from the size of the page showing it; a page that stops at its limit reports the limit and understates what is open
an empty queue names what would fill it, because an empty queue is a fact about the institution rather than a gap in the page
a content type listing is generated from the type itself, so every declared type lists and creates without a per-type branch
a protocol reaches a person as a flow over real state, not as a JSON endpoint they must already know exists
the commerce grammars quote from one service book, so x402, MPP, UCP, ACP and Beckn cannot disagree about a price
the executable catalogue is a subset of the service book, not the same set: x402 settles only what an organ can produce, while the shopping grammars may carry inventory no organ delivers

an agent surface reaches the institution's own organs -- registry, service book, estate, local generation, every carrier -- because a surface that shows only activity lets an agent watch the system without being able to use it
a local generation path refuses when its chain is incomplete and names the missing link, rather than returning to the remote provider that a routing constraint sent the work away from
local generation is a resident service on loopback, not a per-call process launch; a five-gigabyte model reloaded for every prompt is a path nothing will actually route to
an internal organ that authenticates nobody is bound to loopback and denied every other address, because reachability is the whole of its security
a failure that will recur identically is blocked rather than retried; an exhausted account rescheduled on a timer produces a stream of calls that cannot succeed and buries the errors that could
an organ that writes state is told which store to write, never left to infer one from a home directory a service does not have

a durable row state that means work is in flight is reconciled against live runs; without reconciliation a process that dies without raising strands the row forever and the store reports activity that no actor is performing
a store with more than one writer is reclaimed by staleness, never by a startup sweep; a sweep that assumes single-instance hands the same work to two runners at once
a pause is scoped to what it can actually stop; a stop file that halts one daemon while other writers share its store leaves both readings true and neither complete
usage telemetry never invalidates the response it describes; a completed and billed generation discarded during token accounting is paid for twice and delivered never
an empty protocol world names what it is waiting for and the one act that fills it, rather than presenting itself as complete
a subject is addressable and answers with itself plus the operations that pertain to it, rather than a person navigating to a feature and filling a form
an aperture is computed per viewer from identity, the capability registry, runtime reachability, session closure, authority and cost; it is never a static menu
visual weight in an aperture is a projection of closure, so the strongest action is the one that viewer can most usefully take
a relation is a direction, offered only when the graph has somewhere to go; a direction the source cannot support is named rather than hidden
a lens alters selection and representation independently, so a selection can be shown differently and a representation can be reused over other objects
a lens lives in its address, not in a stored preference, so sharing the address shares the exact cut
a room is navigation continuity with representational discontinuity: arrival is uniform, and what is found is shaped by what the subject is
a room states which of its bands the source cannot supply, rather than rendering an empty frame as though the data were merely missing
every carrier listed on a subject is a coordinate of that one subject, never a copy that could diverge from it
creation is read into a typed proposal and shown before anything exists; the person chooses the type, and a wrong reading costs a click
a composed type is created through the organ that owns that kind, so it is the same object every other surface sees
a sentence that proposes several things at once is read as a combination, offered above its parts, and creates each part through its own organ in order
a combination reports part by part: a part that failed is named as failed rather than omitted, because what was asked for and what became real are different facts
a room exists for a kind only when it was built for that kind; an unbuilt kind is named as unbuilt rather than served a generic frame
traversal is one gesture over changing object grammars: the movement stays fixed while each kind is drawn in its own terms
a traversal position lives in the address, so the same position is the same object for everyone and the sequence is shareable
an interaction trace records the shape of an interaction -- subject kind, closure, offered actions -- never which subject a viewer looked at
a viewer is counted through a salted digest, so repetition is distinguishable from reload without retaining who they were
a shape is proven only when it both repeats and is seen by distinct viewers; anonymous traffic cannot prove a shape because its viewers cannot be told apart
a set of near-identical objects is compressed as a set, ordered so that like sits beside like; compressing each object alone leaves the shared structure unmeasured and unclaimed

the ordering is the lever, not the window size: a set laid out tree-by-tree hides its duplicates beyond any practical long-range window, while the same set laid out by relative path exposes them to a small one

a compression window is part of the frame, so the same window must be declared on the way out; an archive written with one and read without it is not corrupt, it is unreadable by a reader that never opted in
an archive replaces its original only after the original has been extracted again and compared entry for entry, symlinks and empty directories included
a response body that is not text/html is compressed too; nginx compresses only HTML unless told the other types, and every asset a page loads is paid for on every load

forbidden_inferences: an organ running -> the browser holding authority, or the page having been composed here

internal_calculi: an organ binds to selectors the estate already emits -- .region, ol.more, .src, .by, [data-bf-slot] -- so breadth comes from the estate's own vocabulary rather than from per-page wiring
every organ is absent-tolerant: a vendored file that does not load leaves the page exactly as it arrived, because the page was already complete when it arrived
a boundary aperture moves the estate's own sentence and never rewrites it; an aperture that paraphrased a boundary would be stating a weaker one
a chart draws the points the server computed and interpolates nothing, because a line between two observations is a claim nobody made
libraries are vendored and served by this estate rather than fetched from anyone's CDN at read time, so a reader's page does not depend on a third party being up or honest

a composed public page fetches no renderer at all, so it gets the one enhancement obtainable without a library: the aperture, written inline into the single script such a page already carries. Motion, charts, spatial indexes and worker offload stay on the surfaces where fetching a library is allowed

the list organ positions rows the server already sent and renders none of them. A virtualizer that insisted on rendering would have to become the renderer, and then the room would exist twice; measuring and placing is the only part a browser does better than the server
the list organ refuses below sixty rows, because under that there is nothing to win and the cost is a scroll container where the page had none
a virtualised list states its own length on the page, since a list that scrolls without saying how long it is hides its own size
invariants: the browser composes nothing: no organ decides what a page says, what material it carries, or what anyone may do
browser state covers only what this reader is looking at; it is never durable, never shared, and never a fact about the estate
a composed public page carries at most one script, and only where something plays; the organs ride a script such a page already has and never add one
an organ that cannot start records why in window.bfOrganErrors rather than failing silently
a reader with scripting off receives every row of a virtualised list as ordinary HTML, because the rows were in the document before the organ touched them
known_gaps: two organs remain wired and unexercised: tiles registers no basemap because no PMTiles archive is published yet, and space indexes nothing because no surface emits data-bf-points -- the field builds its own index rather than handing points to that organ. Each is a capability available to the next surface that needs it, not a capability in use

the first loader identified a UMD library by diffing window after the script ran. A global declared with var is not enumerable, so every UMD organ silently received an empty object while the libraries loaded perfectly; the exports are now named. The silent catch that hid this is why organ failures are now recorded where a reader can see them
the aperture dismissal was first registered once per note, so opening one aperture fired eighteen listeners that each shut it again; it is registered once

the inline aperture positions itself arithmetically rather than through a collision-aware engine, because loading one would be the fetch this page forbids; near a viewport edge it is clamped rather than flipped
four of the surveyed libraries were not vendored: Orama shipped only a bare re-export, regl-scatterplot needs a peer that is not here, and VanJS and Mediabunny answered 404 at the versions tried

forbidden_inferences: a computed consequence -> an approval
a closable obligation -> a closed one
an amount observed in the mirror -> the amount the source holds

invariants: the engine computes consequences and never applies them; no write occurs on this path and the receipt says so
an obligation the estate cannot resolve is reported unevaluable and never counted as closable; treating an unknown amount as closable is how a close report overstates what was reconciled
over-allocation and under-allocation are carried per obligation and reported beside the net; a single net figure hides that money is missing in both directions
a reconciliation formula is validated against the population before it is believed; summing the gross fee overstated one payment fifty-fold, and only the allocated portion reconciles
financial closure is money work, so it runs on the exact representation and where the data already lives, whatever loss budget is offered

the receipt says whether the system of record was reached, because an empty answer from a database that replied and an empty answer from one that refused the connection were the same dict; every obligation then read "the system of record returned no row for it" while the client had never connected
a failed query is not an empty result; the client's exit status is checked and its error carried, and only the error line, which names the host and the failure and no credential
no direction is claimed while the source is unreachable, and the suite asserts that absence rather than demanding a distinction the run could not compute
the active consequence reader uses read-only SQLite and a read-only MySQL query; failed source access stays unevaluable and no credential value is emitted in the receipt

the machinery is given a namespace, discovers the pack that namespace declares, and reads the reconciliation law that pack states; it holds no product's tables, columns, identifier prefix or schema string

a product is added by writing a pack and a namespace entry, never by adding another compiled code path; the first version carried one product's grammar in its filename, its SQL, its defaults and its schema version
a table or column arriving from a declaration is checked against a plain identifier shape before it reaches a query; a contract is content, and content must not be able to write SQL
known_gaps: the mirror held financial events for 61 of 101 obligations while the source answers for all 101; the oracle store is a partial copy and its gaps read as unevaluable rather than as absent facts
the $148.9M under-allocated figure is a reconciliation position and not a claim about owed money; a payment received and not yet allocated is unreconciled without anything being wrong

internal_calculi: bonfyre-embed binary

prune: --prune-invisible with --input-jsonl and --insert-db deletes stored rows the current visibility rule would refuse, by tokenizing alone and never running the model. On the publication store it examined 22,962 titles, found 1,542 invisible, and removed the 294 numeral-only rows the two earlier runs had stored
invariants: a requested backend that could not be honoured is a refusal, not a warning; an ONNX request that silently produced a hashed-token vector exited 0, and hashed-token geometry is not a learned metric so no distance threshold survives the substitution
the receipt names the backend requested beside the backend obtained, and --allow-degraded is how a caller consents to the difference
single-text ONNX cache identity includes runtime version and hashes of the resolved graph and vocabulary; unreadable assets cannot be satisfied by an old cached vector

the semantic corpus is a bounded, atomic text projection of retained item rows ordered by observation time; its address keys and 400-character body excerpts preserve the existing embedding input contract

embed static --store files each visible vector under sha256(schema, .bfse digest, text), so a pack built from it cannot collide with ONNX cache entries for the same text; invisible rows are not stored

embedding visibility and transactional-store witnesses execute through Bun and bun:sqlite without a Python helper; the contention witness waits for an acknowledged read transaction and fails if its reader exits unsuccessfully

a text none of whose content words the vocabulary can build is not embedded. Its vector would encode its word count and nothing else, so every unrelated text of the same length would sit at cosine 1.000 from it; a missing row answers no query, a collapsed row answers every query wrongly
the pre-tokenizer folds the way uncased BERT folds -- lowercase, NFD, drop nonspacing marks -- from a table generated out of unicodedata, not a hand-kept list of accents

bonfyre-embed agree asks the ResourceAdmission memory ledger before loading the ONNX teacher, refuses (exit 3) without a grant, releases the grant when the session closes, and reports the measured peak footprint beside the estimate so the 2 x graph rule can be checked

a batch reports the rows the store holds, not the rows it tried to write. Every step and every COMMIT is checked, the writer writes only inside a transaction it opened, a failed commit is rolled back and counted not_stored, and a batch with any row not stored exits nonzero. Under a reader holding the store for eight seconds the witness saw 47 reported, 47 landed, 1 not stored, exit 1 -- where the previous writer would have reported all 48 and rolled most of them back on close
a text whose only visible words are numerals is refused as invisible; a surviving digit does not identify a text

a text is refused when its unknown words outnumber its meaningful visible words. This follows from mean pooling rather than from a tuned threshold: every unknown word contributes the same [UNK] token, so once they are the majority the shared [UNK] mass outweighs what the visible words say. On a copy of the store it removed 159 rows beyond the numeral rule

re-embedding an id replaces its vector. sqlite-vec's vec0 does not honour OR REPLACE on its primary key -- a second insert fails with a UNIQUE constraint and the first vector stays -- so the writer deletes the id's vector and inserts inside one transaction
known_gaps: cache identity hashes the selected ONNX graph and vocabulary, not separate ONNX external-data files; externally stored weights need an extended asset manifest before cache equivalence is claimed
responds to --help (live); realizes SID; deeper development toward the BonfyreFS level (WiringSpec consumes/produces, full contract) is ongoing

--input-jsonl was in the usage text and was never parsed. The flag was advertised, accepted by the shell and did nothing: the binary fell through to the usage screen, which reads as a syntax mistake by the caller. A corpus arrives as rows, and writing 22,962 titles to individual .txt files to satisfy --input-dir is a detour through the filesystem for no reason.

the batch path opened the vector store at the --dims default of 384 while the model produces 768, then inserted without checking the result. It reported two hundred embedded and stored nothing usable; a corpus that reports success and holds unusable rows is worse than one that fails. The store is now opened at the width the first embedding actually returns, and a row of a different width is refused rather than written.

the pre-tokenizer walked bytes with ASCII predicates. isspace, ispunct and tolower see nothing above 0x7F, so "women's" with a typographic apostrophe was one word whose tail missed the vocabulary and became [UNK], "São" kept its combining tilde and missed, and uppercase Cyrillic was never lowercased. On this estate's 22,962 headlines that touched 11.8 percent through curly quotes and dashes, 5.4 percent through accented Latin and 4.6 percent through uppercase Cyrillic. "The best rivalry in women's tennis" and "Palmeiras bate o São Paulo" each went from a partially unknown text to zero unknown words.

the English vocabulary carries Cyrillic, Bengali, Arabic and CJK as single characters and not as word pieces, so correctly folded text in those scripts is still invisible: "Уроженка Москвы впервые выиграла турнир" is five unknown words of five. That is a property of the model, not the tokenizer, and those titles are now refused rather than stored; searching them needs a multilingual embedder this estate does not have installed.

measured on the corpus before the fix: 36 texts sat in cosine-1.000 pairs with unrelated headlines. The first refusal rule caught 21 of them and let 15 through, because it counted a surviving comma as a visible word; the rule now counts content words only.

the default model name resolves to a directory that does not exist, so onnx embedding fails over to a refusal unless --model names the installed nomic-embed-text-onnx. The refusal is correct; the default is not.

jsonl_reader_open, jsonl_reader_extract, jsonl_reader_close and embed_text_native are defined and called from nowhere -- a JSONL reader was written for the batch mode and never wired, which is how --input-jsonl came to be advertised and unparsed.

the vector writer checked no sqlite3_step result and no COMMIT result and returned success unconditionally, and it opened a transaction only when none was active. A single COMMIT failing with SQLITE_BUSY under a concurrent reader left that transaction open; every later insert saw autocommit off, skipped BEGIN and COMMIT, and rode the orphaned transaction until sqlite3_close rolled it back. Resuming the publication corpus it reported 6,963 rows stored and 1,216 landed -- a clean prefix of 2,463 input lines persisted and nothing after -- and the loss was found only because the store's row count failed to match the sum of two runs.

texts whose only surviving words were numerals passed the invisibility rule, which counted any visible word. A Japanese truck crash and an Urdu shooting that each kept a "4" embedded at cosine 0.980, the highest cross-feed pair in the corpus after the fully invisible texts were removed.
resident memory held at 185-204 MB across a 46-sample resumed batch, so the earlier kill of the full embedding run was system memory pressure and not growth in the batch loop.

the agree estimate rule (2 x graph bytes) ran about 2 percent under the measured peak on the 1703-passage run; the grant is an estimate, not a ceiling, and the single-text and batch embed paths still load ONNX without a memory grant
the single-text path also called the writer without checking it and printed "Inserted ... into ..." after a failed commit; it now reports the failure and exits nonzero

the collapse the invisibility rule was written to stop survived it in a subtler form: texts with seven of eight words unknown kept one incidental token and collapsed onto it. Two differently worded Russian headlines about a Zelensky-Putin meeting sat at cosine 1.000 on "g20" and two Ukrainian drone headlines at 1.000 on "sargan". Because the surviving token was the topic, the pairs read as cross-feed corroboration and headed the corroboration list, which is the most dangerous way a representation can fail.

under the unchecked writer, re-embedding a changed text replaced its artifacts row and, because vec0 refused the replacement silently, kept the old vector beside the new text. The store would have described one headline and returned another headline's neighbours. Found by testing replacement on a scratch store before relying on it, not by reading the insert.

the kernel is compiled to LLVM IR at build time with two sentinel constants where a tensor's rows and blocks-per-row go; at run time the sentinels are replaced, the ordinary O3 pipeline is run for the host's CPU and features, and the code is linked in memory. a state is a delivery because the compiled lifecycle says that state delivers, and for no other reason; a caller comparing state strings itself is a caller that will eventually compare the wrong one

a blocked destination names the binding it lacks, because a blocked state with an empty reason is indistinguishable from a bug

invariants: compiling admissibility can never produce a delivering state, because it materializes nothing
a compiler owns only the states it computes: a recompile may move a row between admissible and blocked and may not touch one that has delivered
a delivery is refused across catalogue generations rather than continued, so a receipt never names bytes that were not in the release it claims
a failed delivery writes no state and never alters what was observed
stale is not withdrawn: a staled delivery keeps its receipt and its count, and what was delivered is still there
the bytes a receipt names exclude when they were written, because a fragment that carries its own timestamp can never hash the same twice

forbidden_inferences: a proposed chain -> a runnable chain (binding is separate)
a seeded edge -> an executed transform; nothing in the lattice has run a binary
a carrier family -> every retained body being that carrier; the edge carries the rate, not a certainty
the estate-wide retention rate -> a per-phenotype rate
a chain not refused as a detour -> a useful chain; only a modality round trip covered by a shorter chain is refused
internal_calculi: bounded enumeration of simple paths to --depth, ranked by the unfloored confidence product less drift less amortised cost
modality transition loss: an edge whose command carries material into a different modality loses 0.15, one that does not loses 0.03

execution: a proposed chain is walked hop by hop with the real binaries, each hop's output taken from the manifest that binary writes rather than from a filename guess, and a declared carrier passed down to the command that can use it
invariants: a prior on the estate bridge is measured or the edge is refused; bf_discipl_seed_estate_bridge returns 2 rather than substituting a default. The measured rate is 0.513 -- 2,505 of 4,885 occurrences have a body on disk now -- and is per occurrence, because the lattice starts from an occurrence and not from a fetch

the carrier edge is conditional on the phenotype that declares the carrier, never on the retained body. Seeded from the body it made all fifteen phenotypes equivalent; conditional, EVENT reaches RSS at 0.990 and SERVICE_CAPABILITY reaches OpenAPI at 0.012 and thirteen phenotypes reach no carrier at all

a carrier with no observed population gets no family; a probe that has never fired contributes nothing. Three of the nine detectable carriers have one: RSS at 474 occurrences, Atom at 26, OpenAPI at 19
a hop's output is what the binary declared it produced. A binary that exits zero and leaves no declared output fails the hop; its stdout is never passed to the next command as if it were material
an invocation is bound only after it ran and left something on disk; exit zero alone binds nothing

a call whose usage names a database, a URL, a model or a key is never probed. Finding out how to call it would mean writing to real state or touching the network, and an unbound command is a smaller cost than either

a command with no checked argv stops the walk and is named. An invocation is bound only after it has been run and its output looked at -- four of twenty-seven are, and a guessed argv that exits zero would let a receipt claim a hop ran when nothing happened

a chain that leaves a modality and returns to it is neither proposed nor stored when a shorter chain to the same goal passes through the same families in the same order without that trip, at no greater cost or loss; it is listed under refused_detours with the chain that covers it
a round trip that is the only route stays proposed, and a longer chain that changes what a later step receives is a different output and is not a detour
known_gaps: the lattice contracted 104 edges and had executed none of them, which made every score a claim about a claim. Chains now run end to end on retained bodies -- carrier RSS, ingest to normalized text, hash to digest -- and invocations are no longer checked one at a time by hand: `bind-commands` reads each binary's own usage, derives the file-in calls it claims to accept, and binds one only after running it and finding something on disk that was not there before. Seven of twenty-seven are bound that way; 12 offer no call that takes a file without also naming a database, a URL, a model or a key, and 4 print no usage block at all.

binding by execution proves a call works and cannot prove it is the right call. The prober demonstrated this on itself: offered every safe shape bonfyre-tag accepts, it bound `detect-lang`, which exits zero and writes a file and is not what Tag declares it makes -- `predict` needs a trained model and is refused as unsafe to probe. Shapes are now tried in the order of what the command declares it produces and every binding reports whether the call it found names a declared output. T_TAG's says false.

the first runner hardcoded ingest's output as normalized.txt and fell back to the hop's stdout when that was missing. On a body with no extension ingest detected `unknown`, wrote the file under its original name, and the chain carried ingest's own log into the hash. Both hops reported ok and the composition was wrong -- exit zero is not review, and a silent fallback is how a wrong answer gets a receipt.

a carrier measured on the bytes did not reach the command that could use it: a walk starting at T_CARRIER_RSS told ingest nothing and ingest detected `unknown` on a feed the estate had already proven was a feed. The start family is now read as well as the hop destinations.

the two witnesses this entry carried were both .py.archive -- archived files that cannot run. It held `implemented` on evidence that had been deleted, which is the laundering the atlas forbids one level in: the maturity was checked once and the witness was retired without the claim being revisited. A live witness now stands in their place.

the engine honoured --depth only to 2. It searched for a direct edge, then for one intermediate, then reported candidate_chains: [] -- an authoritative negative about paths held in its own table. T_WORKFLOW_STAGE -> T_QUEUE_JOB -> T_EXECUTION -> T_LEDGER_EVENT -> T_VALUE_CAPTURE is four contracted edges and was reported unreachable at --depth 6. The emptiness of discipl_chains was never about the chains.

every proposal was keyed discipl_chain:discipl-proposal, so each one replaced the last and the table could not accumulate more than one row per verb. Chains are now identified by the families they walk.

the reach difference between phenotypes was an evidence gap until conformance was run on every receipt. It is now a coverage fact with a measured floor: across all 3,316 receipts, 523 bodies conform, 2 carry a carrier no phenotype declares, 1,964 carry nothing the nine probes can detect, and 325 name a body this estate no longer holds. Running it everywhere added four conformances. The thirteen phenotypes that reach fewer terminals do so because their bytes carry no detectable carrier, not because nobody looked -- but `no_carrier_detected` still means nine needles found nothing, never that the body carries none.

the conformance compiler had only a single-receipt entry point, so sweeping the estate meant parsing 4,891 occurrences once per receipt. The evidence gap was a cost of the interface, not a decision about the sources; a batch mode that parses the corpus once closed it in one run.

carrier detection returned the same value for a body that matched no probe and a body that is not on disk. A sweep reporting both as nothing-detected reports an absence of evidence as evidence of absence, about 325 receipts whose bytes this estate has lost. They are separate outcomes now.

the search still finds compositions that are legal and worthless when they are not a covered round trip. A speak-then-listen chain with no shorter alternative is proposed, ranked last by modality loss; conversion cost is a declared prior, not a measured time or energy, and nothing asks whether the output serves the consumer that requested it.

the bridge emits `rows_claiming_a_body` for rows carrying body_path and body_bytes. That is the right denominator for "can I hand bytes to a binary" and it is not a count of retention claims, which is a different and much more honest number. The two were briefly reported as one.

counting observation rows instead of occurrences inflated the bridge prior from 0.513 to 0.691. An occurrence observed twice contributes twice, and "did this fetch work" is not the question a chain rooted at a phenotype asks. Both rates are now emitted so the difference stays visible rather than being quietly chosen.

the `source_retained` rung was awarded for the presence of a `body_path` field rather than for a body, and nothing re-checked it after the writer set it. Verified against the filesystem it costs 3 rows of 2,885 -- the rung was substantially honest and is now checked rather than believed. An earlier note here read the 691 rows that name a body whose bytes are gone as 691 false retention claims; every one of those is a `boundary_response`, a lower rung that never claimed retention, and the stronger number was mine from conflating "names a body" with "claims the rung".

451 occurrences name a boundary-response body this estate no longer holds. Recovering them means re-fetching 451 external hosts, which is an outward act rather than a repair, so the claim is checked and left standing at the rung it actually earned.

the 17 terminal families a retained body cannot reach are not one gap but two: 13 are model-internal and need weights rather than documents, which is correct and permanent; 4 root in capability, telemetry, alert and graph, which are real roots this bridge simply does not touch.

the engine ranked chains and could not answer which combinations of them fit a budget, which is the question an operator actually has: nobody runs one chain. That is a subset-sum over accumulated cost, and it is now stated as a pure job rather than answered here, so the tier decides where it may be computed and a second reducer checks the answer.

the engine's scores had no second opinion until now. Agreement between the interaction net and enumeration says the search is computed consistently; it says nothing about the declared priors both were handed, which remain unmeasured.

forbidden_inferences: a promoted item -> an endorsement, a republication right, or a claim that what the feed said is true
corroboration across sources -> truth; independent syndication of one wire story is one source wearing several names
this corpus -> currency; every item is as old as the body it was promoted from
invariants: an item is identified by source, link and title hashed together, so re-promoting a feed adds nothing and a feed that repeats an item stores it once
every promoted item carries assertion_state OBSERVED and a rights basis of retained-public-rss-observation; the estate records that a foreign party said this, never that it is true
a field whose bytes are not valid UTF-8 is transcoded from latin-1 rather than stored raw; text that is already well-formed is untouched
feed text is XML: entities are decoded once, after identity is computed from the bytes as the feed wrote them, so decoding changes what is stored and never which occurrence an item is
known_gaps: the promoter existed, was correct, and had never run: `internet_source` held zero rows, so a native path from a retained feed body to publication items sat complete and unused while the estate had 500 conformant feeds on disk. Cataloguing the feeds was mistaken for having their contents.

promoting one source per process reloads and validates 54 content-type schemas before reading a single item, so most of the wall time of a 500-feed estate was spent re-reading its own schema directory. A batch form that keeps the loop inside one process was added for that reason.

the promoter copied feed bytes into a TEXT column without transcoding them. 100 of the first 6,281 titles were invalid UTF-8 -- a publisher declaring ISO-8859-1 put raw high bytes into the database, SQLite stored them without complaint, and every reader afterwards had to guess. Measured on the corpus before it was fixed.

corroboration is counted on normalized title and canonical link, which finds identical syndication and misses the same event reported in different words. Semantic corroboration needs the vector index over this corpus and has not been built.

this corpus was built as row-by-row SQLite inserts at roughly six seconds a feed while the estate holds an activated columnar substrate for exactly this shape of work. Daft and Lance are registered at `measured`, Parquet already carries 544MB of observation facts with a digest-and-slice contribution model, and none of it was consulted. The pipeline is correct and the storage choice was made by not looking.
Feldera and Hydro are activated substrates for incremental and distributed dataflow, and a 500-feed promotion is the shape of work they exist for. It ran as a serial loop in one process.

the promoter refreshed the family index once per row and then, after that was fixed, once per feed -- and an index rebuild costs the whole table, so a 500-feed promotion was quadratic in the corpus it was building. Deferred to one rebuild at the end of a batch, the full estate promotes in 170 seconds where a feed alone had cost six.

the corpus is indexed on hashed-token geometry and the retrieval is noise: a tennis seed returns a train crash and a birdhouse, an earthquake seed returns figure skating. Only the identical-title neighbour is genuinely near, which is corroboration rather than retrieval.

two organs of this estate disagree about that geometry. `bonfyre-embed` refuses to return a hashed representation when a learned one was asked for -- "hashed-token geometry is not a learned metric and distances are not comparable across the two" -- and the CMS ANN index builds one and serves it. The refusal is right and it is not enforced anywhere but in the organ that makes it.

the estate had a working learned embedder the whole time and could not find it: the default model name resolves to a directory that does not exist, while nomic-embed-text-onnx is installed with its vocab and produces 768-dimensional vectors. The corpus was indexed badly because a default pointed at nothing.

the first 22,962-item corpus and its half-built vector store were written to a session scratch directory and were lost with it. The rebuild lives under ~/.bonfyre/estate/publications beside the estate it was promoted from, because a corpus is estate state and not an intermediate result.

the learned index answers where the hashed one could not: "tennis championship final" returns the tennis items at cosine distance 0.906-0.959, where the CMS hashed-token index had returned a train crash and a birdhouse for a tennis seed. The CMS ANN index is still hashed and still served; nothing yet routes corpus search through the learned store.

the first learned re-embedding was stopped at 3,160 rows and discarded: it was being written by a tokenizer that stored collapsed vectors for non-Latin titles and dropped typographic punctuation into [UNK] for Latin ones. The store is rebuilt from zero by the corrected tokenizer, because one corpus written by two tokenizers is two geometries with one name.

about 7 percent of the corpus -- Cyrillic, Arabic, Bengali, Devanagari and CJK headlines -- is invisible to the installed English model and is refused at embedding rather than indexed; those items remain in the corpus and are unreachable by semantic search.

the promoter stripped tags and unwrapped CDATA and never decoded an entity, so 1,799 of 22,962 titles (7.8 percent, from 216 feeds) and 1,200 links were stored as markup -- some Cyrillic feeds entirely as hex entities. The embedder then read "quot" and "x43e" as words, and titles sharing an escaped quote embedded as near-duplicates. Rows were repaired in place by `bonfyre-cms publication repair-entities`, keeping all 22,962 occurrence ids distinct, and the repaired titles re-embedded.

6 titles still carry an entity after decoding, because their feeds escaped twice: "&quot;" decodes once to """. XML decodes once and a second pass would be a guess about the publisher's intent, so they are left as the feed wrote them.

the learned store holds 21,221 of 22,962 titles at 768 dimensions. 1,741 are refused as too little seen by the English vocabulary; the last pass pruned 199 rows the tightened rule no longer admits and replaced the vectors of 1,679 entity-repaired titles. Every stored row's text equals its corpus title, and artifacts and vectors agree row for row.

semantic corroboration now finds the same event in different words across different feeds -- a Chile nursing-home fire, a Philippine ferry death toll, the BRICS declaration, a Zomato cash-on-delivery fee -- with no differently-worded pair at cosine 1.000 and no pair at or above 0.90 that shares no word. Before the tokenizer, entity and visibility fixes the top of the same list was collapse: headlines matched on "g20", "sargan" and an escaped "quot". 116 cross-feed pairs sit at or above 0.90. Nothing here calibrates a threshold for "the same event", and near neighbours remain candidates for corroboration rather than corroboration.

corpus search on the learned store is reachable only through bonfyre-embed and bonfyre-vec on the command line. The CMS ANN index is still hashed-token geometry and is still the one a surface would query.

forbidden_inferences: a compressed retained body -> different evidence; the compression is filesystem allocation, and every read returns the bytes the receipt hashed
source admission or archive depth -> public program, distribution route, reuse licence, external authority, price quote, or purchase authority
foreign twin cache -> remote authority
observe right -> bind or act right
retained body -> verified availability
weak public supply signal -> exact availability fact
policy exclusion -> absence of external inventory
a 304 -> the thing not having changed in the world; it says the representation this estate holds is still current
a completed sweep -> permission to republish anything it read
a boundary response -> a source that does not exist; it is what the transport said at that moment
policy_excluded -> a source refusing this estate specifically; robots is a standing rule the source wrote for everyone
an RFC 9421 message signature verifying -> factual correctness or reuse permission; it is communication authenticity
a superseded observation -> a deleted one (it remains recorded and readable through history)
a listed conflict -> a source that lied (content changing is ordinary; the institution only has to know its earlier belief is no longer current)
a promoted twin -> a claimed, verified or owned one
a claim -> a verified relationship (AssertionBoundary and Authority decide what it is worth)
an admissible receipt -> a true or useful claim (it says the read was authorized, and nothing about what the bytes say)
a registered twin -> an active, present, or partnered one
a classified kind -> a verified one (someone asserted this is a property source, and that is an assertion like any other)
a bound body -> an admitted fact or a licence to redistribute it
a resolvable closure -> a reachable subject
a derived field -> a new observation (it is one arrangement of the rows it was computed from, and it is stale the moment they change)
a field cell -> a fact about the world (a source observed twice as often is not twice as real)
a regime -> a licence (retaining bytes because a regime permits it does not make retention lawful)
a promoted source -> a claimed, licensed or authorized one
a public promotion path -> a safe one for every observation (the closure an observation belongs to is a property of where its receipt lives, not of the command that reads it)
a default Matrix path that resolves -> the deployment's intended Matrix (it is the first existing store in a fixed order; a host with more than one must still declare BONFYRE_MATRIX_DB)
internal_calculi: a receipt carries two independent sets of facts about one representation: this estate's digest of the bytes it retained, and the source's own statements about what it served -- ETag, Last-Modified, Content-Type, Content-Location, Link rel=license and rel=canonical, RFC 9530 Content-Digest and Repr-Digest, and whether an RFC 9421 message signature was present. Keeping only the first loses the only machine-readable statement of rights a source ever makes

re-observation is conditional whenever a prior receipt carries a validator. Receipts append, so the newest line is the one read for it; a 304 becomes a new observation at a new knowledge time that references the prior body rather than retaining a second copy of it
invariants: a retained body is found under the foreign root this estate is told to use, by the name its receipt gave it, and never outside that directory: a receipt records where a reading happened, not where the estate keeps its evidence now, and an estate that can only read its own bodies from the absolute path they were first written to cannot be moved, restored, or carried onto another machine

every native Project foreign verb derives missing receipt and body directories from BONFYRE_FOREIGN_ROOT; explicit leaf-directory settings retain precedence and an overlong derived path refuses without falling back to another store
a cached projection is not remote truth
a retained observation body is parsed only while it still hashes to its receipt
a retained observation body path is immutable after receipt materialization

a refetch whose bytes match the prior receipt's content_sha256 leaves the retained file in place; a changed body of 64 KiB or more is settled on APFS with transparent compression at the same path, so readers and receipt digests see identical bytes (settle_retained_body in components/BonfyreProject/src/main.c, witness components/BonfyreProject/tests/retained_body_settle_test.sh)

a private institutional or self ForeignTwin observation retains its body and receipt below its closure-derived estate/scope or actor root; the public foreign carrier and a sibling institutional or actor closure cannot enumerate it

a self ForeignTwin workspace enumerates and inspects only receipt filenames derived below the current authenticated actor root, rehashes a selected retained body against its receipt before showing an excerpt, and never accepts a body path, actor root, or public ForeignTwin coordinate from the browser
a projected candidate carries the receipt digest of the body it was read from

a retained-body exact query answers only whether ForeignTwin currently has a receipt for that exact subject and predicate; it remains separate from body rehash, semantic relevance, and every admission decision
a housing AvailabilityCandidate requires a current public observe right, allow decision, attempted fetch, and successful robots preflight on its ForeignTwin receipt
a source excluded by robots or an absent observe right is receipted without fetching its source URL

a bounded byte-range observation preflights robots and observe right before fetching, caps the received body, records sample_observed rather than a full source observation, and never promotes partial bytes as a complete foreign identity

a bounded full-response observation caps the received body without requesting a byte range, refuses redirects because a robots check cannot silently move to another host, and emits source_observed only for a complete successful response; transient design-anatomy bytes may be released after receipt-bound measurement without claiming current availability

the product release projection joins published source contracts to SourceFrontier's authored exact_address (using legacy address only when the ledger has no exact_address column), then joins ItemArchive and observed-price reductions by exact authored source coordinate through bounded indexes; it carries separately authored spatial, media, rights and publisher extraction declarations, and reads distinct SiteProgram identities only through its authored source_collection source_refs bridge: collection fanout is not multiple programs, and program input is never a rendered route or verified delivery

a cross-domain readiness path is only an independently-owned input closure for a later compiler: a declared extractor plus retained archive material is ready_for_extraction and not an extracted spatial/media/rights fact; publisher remains a declared identifier; economics reaches observed only through exact authored source-coordinate price binding; each missing path names its blocked binding

a ForeignTwin page is a bounded carrier slice while release_summary is calculated over the entire owner closure; offset/limit affects only which rich rows cross the carrier, never the reported estate census, readiness totals, economics totals or public-program input totals

a ForeignTwin query is a bounded case-insensitive literal filter over authored source-contract fields (URL, source identity, family, carries, or declared publisher); it returns result total and estate_total separately, never claims semantic relevance, ownership, classification, or a changed whole-estate readiness frontier

every bounded source-release page is deterministically ordered and carries a locally-derived catalogue_generation over its exact owner projection; a later page that names a different expected generation is refused as snapshot_mismatch rather than silently combining two working-set releases. This generation states only local projection continuity, never remote-world immutability or the cause of a change

price observations join a ForeignTwin only through an exact authored source coordinate; an unmatched economic source identity stays visible as unbound rather than being guessed from publisher wording, hostname similarity, item title, or family

a source-supplied digest is held apart from this estate's own and neither is promoted to the other; ours proves the bytes have not drifted since retention and the source's is what the publisher asserted about what it served
robots permitting a read is not a licence to republish; Link rel=license is a separate fact, it is usually absent, and absent means the source stated none rather than that permission exists

a validator is handed back to a source exactly as the source issued it; an ETag contains quotes and a parser that stops at the first one returns a mangled validator that every source ignores, which makes conditional re-observation appear to work while never having worked
an observation is never overwritten: a 404 at one time and retained bytes at another are two records, and the relation between them is computed rather than resolved by keeping only the newer

current content and current availability are separate answers; the most recent observation that retained bytes and the most recent observation of any kind are different questions, and reporting one as both hides bytes held from a source that no longer serves them
a resource that never retained content reports null reachability, not false; false would claim the content held is unreachable about content that was never held

observation, promotion and claim are three standings and none is ownership: observing records that something answered, promoting means the institution chose to be able to name it, and claiming is an assertion by some institution

a twin is promoted only when an observation actually retained bytes; its identity digest is the content digest that was retained and its evidence_ref names the receipt that retained it, so an identity whose digest was invented cannot exist
a twin's identity derives from the address it was observed at, not from a receipt filename that changes every observation
a promoted twin carries an address and a presence, and its presence is LIVE: an observation of the real world stays real even when a demo institution is the one looking
two subjects sharing an identity digest are reported rather than merged; which id is canonical is not the storage layer's call, and collapsing them would strand whatever already references the loser

an observation that retains content promotes its resource in the same act; the one moment an identity is unambiguous is when the bytes that identify it are in hand, and deferring it invites an identity derived later by a different rule beside the one derived here
a failed promotion does not fail the observation; the receipt is written and the bytes are kept, so a resource that could not be named stays observable

promotion refuses a private closure: an observation under an estate or actor root belongs to whoever took it, and publishing one as a public subject would make it readable by everything that can read the Matrix. A caller that means to promote privately must say so and say into which scope

an identity is derived only from a body that still hashes to its receipt; a drifted body is no longer the thing the receipt describes, and an identity taken from it would be attested by a receipt for different content

the estate observes two shapes of external thing and they do not identify the same way: a URL twin is one resource fetched repeatedly, identified by the bytes it last returned; a source is an endpoint observed across many pages, identified by a digest over its sorted distinct page digests

a source twin carries no web address, because the estate holds no route to it; binding an invented URL would assert a route that cannot resolve, which is worse than having none. A presence is still bound, because the source is a real thing observed in the live world
a source identity moves when what the source serves moves and not otherwise; an identity that drifted on re-observation would make every source a new thing each time it was looked at

a claim derived from an observation requires the read to have been authorized under the policy recorded at the time: public observe right, allow decision, attempted fetch, and a successful robots preflight where a 404 counts as success. A body digest proves what a parser read and never that it was permitted to
the admission law is not housing-shaped; any derived claim needs the same five facts, and holding it in one domain's normalizer made it unaskable by anything else

registration and activation are different acts: registering establishes that a stable foreign identity exists, and binds no presence. Observing something does not make it present in this institution's world, or a partner, provider, opportunity or offer
activation and deactivation are authority-gated in both directions; turning a subject on or off in the world is an act, not a side effect of having looked at it

not every twin is mirrored: a hydration regime is authored per twin from MIRROR-LIKE, INDEXED, REMOTE and EPHEMERAL, and a twin with no authored regime is reported as unpoliced rather than defaulted, because an unmade decision is not a decision to mirror
cooling removes bodies a regime says not to keep and never removes a receipt; it reduces what is held, never what is known to have been seen
a regime is enforced where the body is written, not only by a later sweep; a cleanup is undone by the next observation, so a decision not to retain survived exactly until someone looked again
a twin with no authored regime retains its body; an unmade decision must not silently start discarding evidence, so the safe direction is to keep

a twin's applicable actions derive from what it is, not from the fact that it is foreign: subject kind ForeignTwin says only that authority is elsewhere, and investigating ownership is meaningless for a specification as mapping a vocabulary is for a tax roll
a twin's kind is authored rather than inferred from its address; guessing a kind from a hostname is how a merchant becomes a dataset
a kind nobody has declared actions for affords nothing rather than falling back to a generic set; an empty aperture list is an honest answer and a borrowed one is not

the columnar observation estate is a material-plane closure contribution, not a file the estate happens to query; a subject whose closure omits the bytes backing it describes an identity and not a thing

a Parquet row is not an admitted Matrix fact, a subject_candidate is not a MatrixSubject, and an observation row is not a RelationshipGraph edge; the columnar estate is a compressed factual representation and AssertionBoundary still controls admission
a columnar body that is a directory of parts is identified by a manifest digest over its sorted members; digesting one member would describe part of the body as though it were all of it
a closure resource is portable: a filesystem path is a reference only one host can follow, so contributions carry bonfyre://, https:// or urn: and never a local path

a closure can be taken over any subject with an active presence, not only one a hostname resolves to; closures addressed by host alone silently limited the manifest to institutions, and an observation source has no route at all

the closure manifest carries each plane's contributions with owner, representation, resource and exact digest, in both the crate and the field carrier; a manifest that says references are listed below and lists none is worse than one that says the plane is sparse

Parquet and Zarr compose rather than compete: the columnar body holds durable observation facts and the field holds their chunked arrangement, and lowering one into the other is an ordinary derivation

internal_calculi: four dials over one Matrix. Extent is served rather than simulated: /_surface/<name>?extent=card is answered by the address organ, which caps the records, reports what it withheld, withholds the effect class, and refuses an extent above the one the pattern was authored at. Mode narrows a territory to one of its six modes and takes its verbs from that mode. Keep is the retention lattice used as an admission floor. The outside is /foreign/edges for what has been observed and /studio/v1/self/foreign/observe for observing one more -- the estate's own ForeignTwin owner, with its robots preflight and its receipt.

density is a property of the address, not of this browser; the shape is a query string so it can be sent to somebody, and nothing about it is kept in local storage
one extent for the surface and only the exceptions named; an address that spells out every pattern is correct and unusable

extent narrows and never grants: a pattern authored at page extent asked for a workspace is refused rather than clamped, because silently serving less than was asked for is how a surface ends up lying about what it is
the organ withholds the action layer below page extent, not the page; a client that dimmed its own verbs would be a client being polite about a rule
a narrowed pattern reports the count it withheld; a reference that quietly stopped at its budget would read as the whole set

a mode's verbs are a subset of its territory's, and every territory verb belongs to at least one of its modes; holding that in both directions is what caught .life carrying no ASSIGN for a household that had chores to give out

a retention floor hides tiers and says so; that they are not admitted is a different statement from their being empty, and nothing is promoted up the lattice for being popular, referenced or merely surviving

the outside arrives as edges with receipts and never as sentences; from, predicate, to, carrier, observed_at, evidence and claim_state are fields, and claim_state observed is not a claim about the far side
the dial reaches the whole estate rather than one page: the compiled pages load their content from the same /_surface/ paths, so the shared chrome mounts the same control and ?x= narrows any of them
the dial is not drawn where there is nothing to narrow, and does not offer an extent whose only outcome would be a refusal

the retention tier of a pattern is a table in the kit rather than a field on the pattern; it belongs on surface_pattern next to extent, where a CMS write would set it
/console is the same page for a signed-in owner and a stranger; a host's own person and a visitor to that host should not be offered the same dials, and nothing here distinguishes them yet
