forbidden_inferences: an activated pack -> an authorized effect; a closure decides what is composed and offers verbs, and Authority decides every effect at effect time
a pack -> an identity; it holds no authority and no state and no host resolves to one
a resolved closure -> permission to read what it composes
a hidden view -> a pattern that stopped answering; hiding is presentation and a machine asking for it gets the same bytes
a declared demand -> retained bytes

a forwarded activation -> a resolved closure, an applied overlay or an authorized verb; the forwarding cut narrows which packs are worth composing and composition and Authority still happen afterwards
a compiled demand coordinate -> a scheduled hydration; ResourceWeather still does not read pack demand, and an emitted declaration is not a fetch, a reservation or permission to retrieve a body
internal_calculi: a closure is resolved per actor: activations are gathered, dependencies closed to a bounded depth, overlays applied in composition order, and the result is the smallest sufficient set of packs with the views it asks for, the external reality it needs, the capabilities it wants and the policy its overlays tightened to. Versions are addressed by a digest over the pack's own identity, dependencies, demands and overlays, so two packs claiming to be the same is checkable.
invariants: five things never merge: a subject, an institution, a pack, an internet cut and a surface. The moment a pack is an identity it can grant itself authority, and the moment a community is a pack it cannot fork one

an overlay may only hide, add, specialize, present, tighten or default; the list is closed and has no verb for granting authority, widening disclosure, rewriting identity, dropping evidence or promoting an observation to a fact
an overlay using a verb outside that list is reported as refused rather than dropped, because a silently ignored override is a community believing it configured something it did not
a published overlay with no target is refused before native string matching; refusal serialization is bounded and preserves valid JSON even when many overlays are malformed
a tighten narrows and never widens; a later layer may narrow further and can never undo what an earlier one narrowed

composition order binds official, then institution, then community, then household, then scenario, and every level has something in it -- a precedence rule with an empty level is a rule nobody has tested
forking is not installing, installing is not activating, and activating is not authorizing; the four counts differ in the live graph and a closure is built from activations alone
a pack refers to shared bases rather than containing copies; five community packs over one base are one base and five sparse overlays
a scenario is temporary configuration asked for at the time, never an installation and never an institution
a dependency cycle is bounded rather than hung; an authoring error is an authoring error and not an outage
a pack declares demand and does not fetch; the body regime is REMOTE unless a claim depends on the bytes
known_gaps: the nine absorbed Frappe lineages are declared as dependencies and authored as packs by nobody, so a closure that names them resolves past them silently; the edge is recorded and the target is not
PackIR exists only as the digest: there is no dense runtime image, no BFP section and no delta upgrade, so a pack is compact because it is small rather than because it was compiled
a head advances by an authoring act and the governance rule is a sentence on the artifact; nothing enforces the quorum it names
ResourceWeather does not read pack demand yet, so nothing schedules hydration against it; the demand is declared and the scheduler that would consume it is unbuilt

forbidden_inferences: an item on a front -> endorsement, ranking by importance, or that the front holds everything its sources published that day
passing release acceptance -> identity of computed imports, runtime-read fixture data or external package contents outside the declared static closure
reusing one read connection across page sections -> authority to union subjects, widen a SourceCollection, admit an unselected item, or treat the cached projection as current after a later rebuild
a composed page -> an editorial judgement, endorsement or ranking of importance; newest-first is a date order and the lead is simply the newest story
a picture shown from a source -> a licence to republish it, a copy held by this estate, or a claim about who is depicted
an item not withheld -> screened and cleared material; most retained bodies are never looked at by a screen that could see anything
a Watch or Listen region -> rights to show the media, a playback session or a viewer identity
a conversation region -> federation, moderation beyond the owner's accepted state, or membership of the reader
a human label such as Schedule or Map -> the grammar behind it being fully built; the tab links whatever the published route already serves
the absence of machine vocabulary on the page -> the absence of the boundaries it used to state; they moved to metadata and to the machine carriers (manifest, feed, outbox, events)

a source filed under gaming or vulnerabilities -> every item it carries being a release or advisory; source family is acquisition/routing evidence and high-claim routes require their own compiled source/form contract
a matching subject-projection input or route digest -> source truth, current provider availability, rights, authority, endorsement, or a fresh external observation
a video-grid byline regression fixture -> complete browser layout coverage or a successful public release
internal_calculi: a gate is not a failure. A test whose subject is a deployed estate, a private institution or an organ invocation the caller must name has nothing to be right or wrong about when that thing is absent; it says SKIP and names what would let it run, so the red that remains is red that means something

a story reached through a second carrier is one story. page_push_story already refused a repeat inside one stream, but each source is read into a material of its own and merged, so the two copies had never met; the merge now folds the repeat into the copy already held, taking from it whatever that copy lacks -- one carrier often has the picture and the other the dateline

material read back from the durable record is marked as such. It fills a page a thin source would leave empty, but it is not evidence that the source still publishes it: its own page says it was kept rather than being current, and an agenda, which is a claim about what is going to happen, leaves it out
invariants: an apex front (/, /discover, /today on aurekai.work/.life/.live/.shop) is one composer: edition strip, headline with beat chips, lead, then the dispatch grid (work) or watch/listen/reading/what's-on/pictured regions (others), the standard band, and the page ends; no generic regions, sections or continuation blocks are laid under it
a source whose twin was read again after its publication_occurrence ledger was last written is read from the retained body, so a stale ledger cannot pin a front to weeks-old items
public fronts lead to account-scoped applications without displaying an application sample catalogue or a presentation-system showcase
the public conversation entrance does not set the editorial replacement flag, so an empty or unavailable social selection cannot suppress fallback lead material
ordinary WebAddress builds use the portable all target; release acceptance is explicit for one selected frozen candidate and never an implicit developer-specific historical directory

release staging resolves inherited binary links to their existing terminal files, rejects link cycles, and freezes the native Meter executable while connecting an existing configured Meter database to account work

release acceptance uses the selected frozen browser and site trees plus the candidate public CMS and Auth executables; activation requires every current acceptance group with matching verifier, static local fixture dependency, environment and browser executable identity
every browser HTTP fixture reads candidate assets; all frozen modules are compiled to check static imports; companion-only fixture modules are hashed separately from the public HTTP route set
a region exists only when its material kind is present; a subject with only stories grows no empty Watch, Listen or conversation heading
regions that share a material stream consume it in declared order, so one story is never shown by two regions of the same page

the executor branches on region topology and material only; a region role, grammar, source or World name inside it would be a route-local page in disguise (Makefile surface-programs-verify refuses it)
a World fragment's subject address scheme selects the canonical owner reader (community, recording, program); the page never queries media, music or conversation tables for itself

one story reached through two carriers is one story, keyed by title or canonical link, and stories across sources are ordered newest first with an unreadable date sorting last rather than being guessed

visible copy never names the machinery: no World, observed, closure, candidate, grammar, projection, occurrence, character name or subject-address scheme reaches page text; the character is declared in data-character and the cannot-infer statement in a bonfyre:cannot-infer meta element

every composed public document carries an inert bonfyre-surface-scene.v1 compatibility envelope and stable page/region continuity names derived from that exact server emission; the envelope is a hand-off descriptor, never visible copy or browser-owned material

PageComposition never mounts SurfaceRuntime: the exact canonical module is projected as a static asset for a future owned ApplicationBinding, while the compatibility document remains complete and readable without a client compositor

a route with no retained material declines the PageComposition compatibility adapter and falls through to its declared CUE-native surface; an empty compatibility document never displaces an owner-backed native program
a published addressed World with no declared sources still lowers a complete native empty page; absence of source membership cannot reopen the retired browser renderer
a grammar with no human label in page-composition.cue is not linked; an internal name is never a navigation word
tabs are the authored grammar list followed by any other grammar a published fragment opens, so a published way into the page is never reachable only by typing its address
a relative time ("2h ago") is emitted only inside a public projection that lives at most sixty seconds, so it cannot drift into a false statement
a subject reference shown to a person is humanized from its handle until a profile owner supplies a display name; the page does not invent a name

a story's byline is the maker the source names (sub_field, dc:creator, Atom author) when it is short, otherwise the publisher's registrable domain taken from the source URL; a source handle or internet_source label is never shown as a name

retained bodies are read by the census contract the retired browser reader used: dotted and indexed fields, an empty extract as the body itself, {today-iso}-style date tokens, JSON escapes decoded, feed entities decoded (twice, for feeds that escape twice) before the page escapes again

a twin with a published content_flag whose review_state is not cleared is withheld from every page until a person clears it, and an item a source marks nsfw, sensitive, over_18 or is_nsfw (on the item, its post or its community) is withheld without judgement
a video or image source's item joins Watch or Photos only when it carries a picture; the same item without one is a headline, and every other source kind is a story (nativePageSourceKinds)

a picture reaches the page only as an https URL completed by the source's declared image_base (absolute, @host field, pre|post or origin), rejected if truncated or if it contains a quote, angle bracket, backslash or space, and is written lazy, async, with no referrer and empty alt
a remote video is linked to where it was published; only a same-origin safe asset plays in place

a main public route (/discover, /channels, /community, /board, /parcels) is a composed page when page-composition.cue declares a program for it; the program names source families, a source cap and its region sequence, and families fill the cap in declared order a share at a time so every named family contributes

a program's sources are allocated from the whole admitted source ledger when it is present: the channels that have waited longest for a reader come first, no single publisher may hold more than an eighth of a surface's sources and no single protocol more than a third; each route length is an offset in that complete stable order, never an offset inside an arbitrary query prefix, so an admitted source remains reachable through the route's bounded continuation; where the ledger is absent or thin the declared families still fill the page, so a page is never emptier for the ledger existing
a program's source window is no larger than the number of sources its declared rhythms visibly carry, so a continuation never advances past a selected publisher that a reader did not meet

a source whose current retained body no longer lowers still contributes the fields the item archive retained; the archive is a record of what this estate read, not a claim that the source still publishes it or a substitute for richer current source media

a placed thing carries what else this estate holds around it: every placed material (an organizer's GEO, a photograph's own point, a place's coordinates, a wildlife record) within a short walk, nearest first, with the distance measured between the two stated points and said in a person's words; being near something is never shown as being about it

every response leaves through one boundary that compresses it: a body a caller can read as gzip is gzipped (nothing already packed, nothing under 1.4 KB), the answer says it varies by what the caller reads, and a caller that does not read gzip receives exactly the bytes the page composed

what may be packed is decided by the answer's own headers, never by its body: a track list whose files live under /audio/ on their host, or a gallery naming image paths, is a page and is compressed like one

a composed page is kept and served again for a bounded moment: only where it is nobody's in particular (no query, no signed-in reader), keyed by the state of the material it was composed from and by the clock at ten-minute granularity, which is finer than the coarsest thing a page says about time

the estate warms its own pages rather than charging the first visitor for them: the warmer composes each public route exactly as a request would, reads no source, admits nothing, and can only fill what a request would have composed anyway

publication may explicitly defer an external reheat batch and compose the complete retained generation already held; deferral is recorded as such and is never represented as a fresh source observation
a page carries an ETag over exactly the bytes it composed, and a caller that already holds them is answered 304 with no body; a private answer keeps its private cache directive in that answer

the commons that keep this estate's pictures are named in the head as preconnect and dns-prefetch, from the declared picture-origin table, so a browser opens those connections while it reads rather than when it meets the first picture; nothing is fetched there and no other host is named

a time is computed, not switched: reading a calendar entry's moment uses arithmetic for UTC and sets the host's zone only when the zone actually changes, because reloading a timezone database twice per entry cost a page more than everything else it did

`page-contributions` composes every declared route exactly as the server does and reports what each route would show now, by source; it renders to nobody and measures this estate's surfaces, never a reader

the static export follows a public program's own next link until that program ends, bounded by the same four-hundred-length route guard as the server; an arbitrary exporter page cap cannot turn an admitted source into an uncirculated one
a retained-item export is a finite closure: every selected item page must materialize with a 200 body or the generation refuses. A partial archive is never an activatable public release.

the static export also carries the admitted SourceDepth index and every admitted source profile under exact query-coordinate object keys, so the public source lattice does not disappear when its dynamic origin is absent
a family a program does not name never reaches its page; selection is by authored family, never by a title, a URL domain or a source's own claims
an addressed World page uses nativePageWorldRegions; the topics rhythm belongs to main routes and would otherwise take the stories More keeps

a front page's phase is derived from this estate's own clock (nativeHomePhases: the hour each begins, in BONFYRE_LOCAL_ZONE): the phase renames the page and reorders the routes below it, and can admit no material, no source and no route the territory does not already publish; every visitor at the same hour sees the same arrangement, so it is derived composition and never personalization

each territory apex (aurekai.live, .life, .shop, .work and their www. hosts, port ignored) opens on its own composed front page (Right now, Today, Just released, Work) ahead of any SitePresentation naming that apex; institution and subdomain hosts are not territory apexes and keep their own homes, and a machine request to the apex keeps its machine answer

each territory apex has an offline SubjectFabric reader closure over admitted SourceFrontier census sources, and its routes select only explicit estate-owned SourceCollections whose declared family or carried material matches the CUE route; a request consumes the compiled route material and editorial contract and never reopens retained bodies to rediscover global membership

one compiled public route page keeps one resolved host subject and one read-only SubjectFabric connection across route material, region order, editorial contract, compatibility source selection, and every preview section; a section cannot silently resolve a different subject or reopen a different projection generation within that page

a SubjectFabric route cut retains an atomic build manifest over the exact admitted-reader, Scene-query, published-SourceCollection, item-stream, page-composition and surface-program inputs it read; its route digest includes the rendered contract and every normalized renderer-visible item field, and a failed replacement rolls back the entire route-table reset

normalized item payload is stored once per source/item/material coordinate and explicit subject membership remains independent; the subject_material compatibility view reconstructs the prior reader shape for WebAddress without making shared bytes evidence of shared subject identity or authority

an item page opened from a compiled public route reads that route's selected normalized material through the exact host subject and route membership relation; once a verified route cut exists for that host, an unselected item cannot reopen through a legacy source body

a signed-in Save of a compiled item takes the same exact host-subject route membership and normalized material as its item page before any native saved_item write, including repeat Save; an item selected for a different subject or omitted from this route cannot pass through a legacy feed fallback

when a later compiled cut omits an item, the public item page and feed omit it and new Save writes are refused; the actor who had already saved it may still read their own private snapshot until they unsave, after which that page is refused for them too

a territory with a committed subject-route cut publishes its Atom feed from that same host-subject route-item membership and normalized material, never from all same-family retained sources; its item links return to native pages on that host, its ETag is stable until the cut changes, and another territory cannot inherit its entries

the committed subject-route cut is verified by the Bun SQLite and SHA-256 owner in the live automation path; it recomputes the exact bounded input frontier and all projection-table row digests before a route cut is trusted

the Atom feed is a separate read-only native module; AddressPlane resolves the host before invocation, and bounded XML assembly either emits a complete response or refuses it. A declared WebSub hub must be a safe HTTPS address, never an arbitrary header value

a static release that carries a page advertising /feed.atom must carry the same host-scoped Atom response as a file or refuse the release; the exporter cannot reselect feed entries from another source catalogue

the standing route rebuild reads a completed census item generation and a SubjectFabric closure from the same automation run; a failed item export leaves the previous complete item file intact and refuses the dependent route rebuild
a front page names its place (Aurekai) instead of pointing back to it and offers the other territories as Live, Life, Shop and Work

every retained item has a stable page key (a digest of its source and its link, or title) and opens /o/<source>/<key>; no composed page writes an anchor without an href, and an item with neither a page nor a public link is text

an item page's verbs are links or forms that work without a script: play in place (PeerTube embed from the video's own host), view the picture full size, open the place in a map, read or watch at the publisher, share by mail with the page's own address, sign in to save and return, and more from the maker narrowed by ?from=

each main route has its own rhythm and its own families: Discover a mixed feed, Watch a video grid, Channels two panes selected by ?s=, Community groups by who is posting, Boards a picture wall, Map a plate beside its numbered list, Releases and Advisories a ledger, Research an index, Search typed results; no two routes share a family, so a person does not meet the same sources on every page
a front page is sections into those routes, each previewed in that route's own rhythm with its words as the heading and a See all way in, not one more feed
?from= narrows a page to one maker or publisher and ?q= to matching text; both are shown as plain words with a Show all link, and neither selects sources outside the route's families
sources fill a page by fair share (the stream cap divided across its sources) so the first few sources cannot crowd out the rest
search is a GET form in every composed page's header and answers from the retained text of the page programs' families

a property is a continuous subject at /s/parcel/<account>: every open reads the observed Tarrant roll for its facts and its same-street neighbours, offers the parcel aperture's own verbs in plain words (See this market; with write scope Watch this property, Open an opportunity), and falls back to the legacy subject door for an account the roll does not hold and for machine requests
search that reads like an address or an account also searches the observed property roll and lists matches before retained material, each opening its property page
a lead needs a date or a picture; an undated, pictureless item never leads a page
topics group public threads by where they are happening (the publisher), newest first within each, keeping the first-appearance order of places

a place is plotted only from GeoJSON geometry, Darwin Core decimal coordinates or plain latitude/longitude pairs inside the globe; 0,0 is unknown, not a place; points sit on a Natural Earth land mask with no tile provider and no implied precision

a publisher relay host (hn.algolia.com, feeds.bbci.co.uk, api.wikimedia.org, ...) is named for its publisher only through the authored host table; the table replaces a byline and never selects material
a native surface document loads /assets/aurekai-native.css and titles itself with the grammar's human label, so no native route renders as unstyled markup or a program name

the fallback home template carries generated slots for server-resolved identity and authored navigation, the public search form, and the existing home-weather fragment as authored markup; a request does not scan/copy the whole template to splice search, rewrite territory copy, or fetch public weather through a browser compositor, and missing CMS copy stays a generic server-owned floor

published territory-home copy is located against one immutable template and assembled in one allocation; a missing region leaves the original document untouched, and a territory class cannot inject HTML attributes

request-ready route selection indexes published collections by declared subject and reuses normalized item bodies across routes; it must still intersect source readers with exact subject and scope before emitting membership
subject-route plans and material acceptance are compiled once per route shape, while membership, reader intersection, scope and route digest remain subject-specific
video-grid bylines separate the author's name, a distinct publisher and the publication date with literal whitespace, independent of stylesheet spacing
a high-claim reading route admits a publisher by contract, never by source family: being filed under gaming or vulnerabilities does not make an item a release or an advisory
Listen, On this day and Around Fort Worth and Dallas are page programs like every other route: CUE names their families and rhythms, and the executor still branches only on topology and material
a region's picture, playable file and credit come from the item; a lead may be undated only when it has a picture or its own words to lead with
a many-item rhythm (wall, grid, field, map, shelf, tracks, feed) takes turns across sources, each newest first, so one prolific source cannot fill it; reading lists keep time order
undated things take turns by source before being spread through a dated stream
a host that publishes a player for its pages (nativePageEmbedHosts) plays in it; a recording without a file of its own offers Play on its page
a licence address or its words read as what they let a person do (nativePageLicences); unrecognized terms promise nothing

a source is drawn onto a page for what it demonstrably carries, not only for the family it was filed under: carriage is measured from a retained body (a file the source itself typed audio, video or image, or a calendar's events), kept beside the channel with the count that showed it, and never overwrites the family the source was listed under
the publisher-depth page aggregates channel count, protocol count, and read standing once per matched root before ordering; it does not run four correlated channel scans for every publisher row

Releases, Advisories, and their Work previews use the same CUE-compiled route/source contract. A contract matches an exact host suffix and, where declared, whole title terms; it is a selection gate only and never changes the item's owner, kind, source family, occurrence standing, or authority.

Stage is an authored CUE page program over the events family. A focused Stage cuts that event's spatial closure; neither focus nor proximity permits a forum, release, audio, video, or other non-event source to enter.

an explicit /channels SourceDepth cut (channel, publisher, protocol, standing or bounded ledger slice) reads only its maintained SourceFrontier relation; it does not parse unrelated retained bodies before rendering the ledger page

an item's own evidence outranks its source's filing: a story whose source published an audio file is a recording on this estate's pages, a video file makes a video, and a picture file the source typed and published makes a photograph -- a thumbnail standing beside a story never does

no browser renderer: nothing a page says is composed, fetched or replaced by a client. The single script this estate permits drives playback of media the page already named -- it renders no markup, contacts no host, stores nothing, and the page is complete and readable with scripting switched off, its deck hidden until its own script shows it

one deck plays a whole track list in turn, at the foot of the list it plays: a person who starts listening keeps listening, and every file is fetched by their own browser from the source that published it

how much of one kind of material a page may hold is a memory cost, not a free number: every stream is held at that size while a page composes, multiplied by the compositions in flight, and a machine that also runs a model server and an editor has to survive the estate publishing itself

the estate is published twice: as pages a person reads, and as tables a reader can query. The tables choose among pages that already exist and are never a second source of truth -- every row points at something this estate composed, a score between two things remains a measurement of two texts, and a distance remains between two stated points
a reader that asks for part of a published object gets that part: the edge answers Range with 206 and never caches one reader's slice under the whole object's address

a page is a walk, not one look repeated: every region and every front-page section is dressed in a presentation profile chosen for the material it carries, seeded so the same stop looks the same between visits, and the seam between two of them is drawn rather than hidden

a profile the estate has only catalogued dresses a region exactly as a studied one does, and the markup says which standing the one it used has: dressing is this estate's own composition, never a claim to have observed anyone's design
motion is the browser's own: parallax and rise-into-view are CSS, ask nothing of a script, and are absent entirely for a reader who has asked for less motion
a podcast enclosure plays and is never used as a picture; the Podcasting 2.0 namespace's people, place, transcript, chapters and conversation are shown as the show's statements

a subscription notification -> an observation; a notice is a dirty signal and the source is reread through the admission law
a model-derived estimate -> an observed measurement; a PAGER fatality estimate never flattens into observed fatalities
an alert-shaped projection -> authority to warn; CAP sits after AuthorityGraph and a red impact estimate is not permission to issue anything
public source bytes -> something this estate may charge for; a price may attach to admitted analysis this estate added, never to the observation it read
six axes measured -> six axes deep; every one of them is at its lowest rung, and the estate reports longest_owner_path 2 with rejoin_points 0, which is a tree and not yet a braid
an occurrence at depth 1 -> an occurrence that was reached; depth 1 means one owner left checkable evidence about it, and for 4,890 of them that owner read a description rather than a source
an admitted relation -> a lawful one; admission is what the phenotype can carry and AuthorityGraph decides what may be done with it
a bound application kind -> a built application; the binding says what a kind is, not that anything realizes it
a declared phenotype -> a row that exists; several content types carry no rows at all and the binding says what a type is rather than that anything was written into it
a satisfiable requirement -> a permitted action; the relations say what the machine must be able to do for the action to be possible at all, and AuthorityGraph still decides whether this actor may
an enacted read -> a licence to republish or derive, or authority over anything else that source offers
obligations_closed -> the source agreeing that they were; the obligations of a permitted read were discharged at request time and this records that, it does not negotiate it
a quote -> an intention to pay, a budget, or a fair price
internal_calculi: a facet is admitted only if it adds at least one previously unavailable relation from the finite set: DISCOVER, IDENTIFY, AUTHENTICATE, AUTHORIZE, OBSERVE, SYNCHRONIZE, DESCRIBE, QUERY, FILTER, SUBSCRIBE, NOTIFY, TRANSFER, STREAM, PUBLISH, FEDERATE, TASK, COMMAND, NEGOTIATE, QUOTE, COMMIT, PAY, SETTLE, PROVE, VERIFY, ROUND_TRIP

compile facets from the phenotype of the thing crossing the fabric rather than from its domain; one object may carry several phenotypes at once, and a domain-keyed compiler degenerates into `if earthquake then FDSN`

the ladder is five distinct states and collapsing any adjacent pair is the failure mode: a candidate protocol match is not a compiled ProtocolContract, which is not a ProtocolEnactment, which is not obligations closed, which is not an authorized effect

an owner reports participation as a row carrying the digest of what it read and the digest of what it produced. Neither is decoration: a reader that accepts an axis, an owner and a state at face value lets any owner write itself onto any rung, and the reader did exactly that -- it ended in `return raw`, so a document claiming economic/settled was counted as a settlement

the axes are declared with their rungs in one place and the reader refuses a state that is not a rung of its own axis, so a new owner can report without a new reader and cannot invent a ladder for itself

density is relations carried and never names declared. This estate holds thirty string-union grammars and four hundred and thirteen members; fifty-eight of those members appear nowhere but their own declaration, and the widest grammar, #ApplicationKind, had forty-three of fifty-nine dead

a grammar earns density by binding to another grammar, not by growing. #ApplicationKind named fifty-nine applications and carried nothing, so the facet compiler -- which types four thousand external occurrences and derives twenty-five relations from their phenotypes -- could not see a single site application. Binding each kind to the phenotypes it is makes the relations follow instead of being restated per capability program

a kind carries several phenotypes because a thing is often more than one. A Marketplace is an economic offer and a dataset; a Podcast is a media asset and a versioned record. The compiler already types occurrences with several at once and the binding matches it rather than forcing a single answer

the estate's own rows enter the relation grammar the same way external ones do. The facet compiler typed 4,891 external occurrences and none of the 54 content types carrying the institution's own data, so it could propose relations for the outside world and nothing for the inside: a media_program could not be known to be a media asset, a pack_demand could not be known to be an obligation

the estate is no longer one thing and the grammar says so. Twelve domains -- pack, music, media, community, site, surface, external, spatial, governance, contract, frappe, cms -- are separate bodies of meaning over one relation spine, which is what lets a question be asked across them rather than inside one of them

three vocabularies described the affordance and nothing checked they agreed: the forty-four #ExternalAffordance declares, the thirty-eight the compiler mapped to relations, and the thirty-eight the estate's data carries. Six were declared and mapped to nothing, so a source arriving with SHIP would have contributed nothing to its own facet set and no one would have been told

the fourth law is mechanical where it belongs. #StandingAction names twenty-eight things a person does and was read by nothing at all; binding it says which six computation may carry to completion and which twenty-two are a commitment no engine may close on someone's behalf

a bound grammar is a description until a protocol can carry it. Ability is the protocol: 739 of them each offer some subset of the twenty-five relations, and a grammar member is executable exactly to the degree that one of them offers what its phenotype admits. `reach` answers this for a phenotype set, which is what a bound grammar has, because `compile` answers it only for an occurrence and an application kind is not an occurrence and never will be

how many grammars are bound is answered from cue's own normalised definition and not from the source text. Two regex attempts over the schemas gave two different wrong answers: the first called ExternalAffordance and RelationKind bare, which are the two most bound things here, and the second missed every list element type because it required a colon or a space before the reference where the text has a bracket or a dot

a ForeignTwin receipt is the ExternalEstate handoff and never says so, because the observer records what it saw rather than who handed it the occurrence. Both readers of the evidence must synthesise that edge or neither may; one did and one did not, and the estate's own first hop was absent from every density report it had produced

the rungs above contract_compiled were called unreachable because each needs an actor, an authority or money, and all three existed the whole time pointed at nothing. The one interaction this estate has actually performed is a read, and a read has all three: the actor is the identity the source was shown, the authority is the source's own robots rule, and the money is nothing because a permitted GET of a public representation costs nothing

a contract is compiled for the relation that was performed and not for the first one the compiler proposes. Taking the first shape-derived facet produced AUTHENTICATE contracts against a thousand sources nobody authenticated to and PUBLISH contracts against sources whose own receipt says robots allowing a read is not a licence to republish

phenotype has a third derivation tier and it is the only one that rests on bytes. Shape reads what a thing is described as and domain reads the neighbourhood it sits in; both were available before anything was fetched and both are guesses. A carrier detected in a retained body is the source saying what it is, and 451 of 519 conformant occurrences were typed by observation after the catalogue had typed them otherwise

a price is not a payment. Three sources answered the sweep with HTTP 402 and an x402 envelope, which is a published price, and reading it cost nothing. quoted is rung one of five and committed, paid, settled and reconciled all remain unreached because all four move money
invariants: a protocol adds a relation and never acquires ownership of a fact already owned elsewhere; seventeen projections of one earthquake are seventeen carriers over one typed closure and not seventeen earthquakes
every owner handoff leaves occurrence-keyed evidence, because a handoff that leaves none is a handoff nobody can measure and a running chain reports as depth zero
density is measured as branching and rejoining over one occurrence, not as the longest path; a straight line of eight owners is not denser than six branches that rejoin

a source-native carrier and a Bonfyre projection carrier are different facts about different hops; SeedLink is what a seismic source speaks and MOQT is how this estate may deliver an addressed object, and neither substitutes for the other

an owner emits the lowest rung it actually earned and never one above it; the address plane emits discovery/routable because it can form the address, and refuses capability/eligible because eligibility needs a lowerer that survives an exact cut

a rung that requires something this estate cannot grant itself is not emitted from local compilation. semantic/carrier_conformant outranks profile_bound, which requires a retained body, so deriving conformance from declared metadata would launder a rung above one that needs real evidence

the phenotype relation table is emitted by its owner and never re-parsed. It lived only as a multi-line C initialiser, and a line-indexed parse of a table whose rows wrap attributes one phenotype's relations to another -- it reported that a Checkout admits VERIFY and not PAY, which is neither true nor what the table says
a binding names only phenotypes the compiler holds; a grammar that binds to a phenotype nothing implements is two vocabularies wearing one name

COMMAND is reachable from application kinds and not from content types, because COMMANDABLE_RESOURCE is a device phenotype and nothing the CMS holds is a device. The witness asserts this rather than assuming it, so a content type that ever claims COMMAND has to justify holding a commandable row
neither grammar has to reach every relation alone; together they must. Site applications reach all twenty-five and authored rows reach twenty-four, and the pair is what the estate can actually derive
data stays inside its grammar. The witness refuses an affordance the data carries that #ExternalAffordance does not declare, and an affordance the compiler maps that nothing declares

anything that moves money, grants authority or discloses is a commitment. BUY, SELL, FUND, APPROVE, APPLY, SHARE, ESCALATE and JOIN are asserted rather than left to drafting care, because an engine that could close them on a person's behalf is what the fourth law exists to prevent

every grammar member is servable by at least one protocol. All 141 members across the three bound grammars are, with a range of 310 to 730 protocols each; a member no protocol can serve is a name that cannot be executed however well it is typed

a vocabulary declared twice is compared twice. The axis set is declared as #AddressAxis and again inside the #AddressTerm pattern, and only the pattern was ever compared with the native plane; all three agree at sixty-eight and the witness now checks all three rather than two

no authority is granted by this estate to itself to reach a rung. The read relation reports authority_required false, so the flag that would grant one is not passed and cannot be the reason anything closes

a rung is reached only where the evidence still holds at the moment it is claimed: robots allowed, the fetch returned 200, and the retained bytes still hash to what the receipt recorded. A body that has drifted from its receipt is skipped rather than enacted on a weaker basis
known_gaps: native enact still accepts no receipt and does not bind the original observer identity; ACTOR is a caller assertion, retained allow is not current permission, and DB plus evidence-file writes are not one transaction. The Bun retirement does not claim these native boundaries are closed.

the household audience is bound by no application kind and no content type. Either something household-scoped is unwritten, or that audience belongs to a body other than a site application or an authored row

the machine-readable internet offers reading in abundance and proof almost not at all. The four scarcest relations -- PROVE, ROUND_TRIP, SETTLE, VERIFY -- are exactly the four that turn an observation into a settled and verified fact, and that shape explains this estate's own numbers rather than excusing them: 3,316 observations, 2,344 reads enacted, nothing settled. It is a fact about the corpus and not a defect here, and the witness asserts the scarcity so a change that appears to make proof abundant is looked at rather than believed

an earlier note in this entry claimed twenty-six of thirty grammars were unbound. That figure was never measured and is wrong by the width of the claim. CandidateKind is mirrored in C with a witness proving the two sets identical, ExpectedPredicateState is mapped by nativeOwnerPredicateGrammar through owner, opcode and native state, and AddressAffordance is carried by PHENOTYPE_AFFORDANCE. The retraction is kept here because the number was reported before it was checked

SHIP, STORE, CONTROL, RESERVE, FINANCE and NOTIFY are mapped and carried by no occurrence in the estate. The mapping is a prepared answer rather than a measured one, and the first source that carries one will be the first test of it

the law is stated and only partly enforced. The relation vocabulary is not yet a validated field on a ProtocolFacetContract, so nothing refuses a facet that adds no relation; participation_report measures the ladder and does not gate on it.

the braid branches and does not rejoin. branch_points is 1 and rejoin_points is 0, because every rung that would join two owners into a third needs an observation, an authority or a price. The rejoin is not missing work; it is work that cannot be done without leaving this machine.

the economic axis has five declared rungs and three quotes. The earlier reading -- that a quote needs a price from a carrier this estate does not hold -- was true of the carriers and false of the sources: three answered with HTTP 402 and a published price. The other four rungs move money and remain unreached, which is a decision and not a limitation.

146 facts are produced by an architecture nothing consumes and 55 are consumed by an architecture nothing produces. Those pairs are where the rejoin would come from, and until they are closed the estate is a set of owners that each report separately rather than a machine that hands work along.

phenotype compilation is described and unbuilt. Facets are still authored per protocol family rather than selected from the phenotypes an occurrence carries, so the abstraction jump this entry names has not been taken.

forbidden_inferences: a candidate facet -> a compiled contract, an enactment, closed obligations, or an authorized effect
a protocol offering a relation -> that protocol being reachable, admitted, or lawful on this subject for this actor
7.1 million candidate facets -> 7.1 million available interactions; this is candidate adjacency across the estate and realized participation is measured separately and is far smaller
a phenotype -> an observation; a phenotype is a shape read off a description and no position, measurement or record follows from it
a phenotype distribution of zero -> the phenotype being wrong; this corpus carries no evidence shaped like it, which is a fact about the corpus
internal_calculi: a facet is the intersection of three things: a phenotype the occurrence carries, a relation the protocol offers, and that relation being meaningful for that phenotype. Drop the phenotype and this is domain matching; drop the protocol's own offer and it invents capability; drop the meaningfulness table and a payment protocol acquires a relation over a weather field

phenotypes are derived from evidence the corpus already carries and already witnesses -- candidate affordances, estate roles, topic domains, the spatial classification -- rather than from a fresh reading of the same descriptions, which would be a second opinion with no extra evidence behind it

evidence comes in two tiers and they are never merged. Shape evidence is an affordance or role that names what the thing is and is sufficient alone. Domain evidence says what a domain is mostly made of -- a deed, a permit, a policy and an invoice are versioned records, so law, government, housing and finance carry VERSIONED_RECORD -- and is weaker, so every facet records which tier admitted it
a facet names the protocol families its phenotype is usually carried over, so it says which relation is possible and over what; AddressPlane still addresses affordances and never protocol names

invalidation is per phenotype because density is only affordable if it is precise: a moving thing is invalidated by moving and not by a price changing, and more protocol projections must not mean more recomputation

AddressPlane coordinates for a facet are affordances and never protocol names; a live bus and a private physiological reading share temporal:live and are separated by InformationPolicy and Authority rather than by routing vocabulary
invariants: the relation and phenotype vocabularies are finite and declared once in CUE; the compiler's own lists are compared against that declaration, because two independently maintained copies is how a finite vocabulary stops being finite

a compiled facet claims candidate_match and nothing higher unless something witnesses the next rung; promotion to contract_compiled requires the facet to be one this compiler would emit, a ForeignTwin receipt for that exact occurrence whose body still hashes to it, and a registration performed by the native ProtocolContract owner
the program count on a compiled contract is what the native registrar returned and never a number chosen by the promoter
a protocol binding carries the digest of the domain binding under it and the domain binding carries the digest of the receipt under that; a contract with nothing beneath it does not verify

a contract's shape follows its relation; describer/compiler/reader is lawful for a read and wrong for anything that changes something, so COMMAND, TASK, COMMIT, PAY, SETTLE, AUTHORIZE, PUBLISH, TRANSFER and FEDERATE construct an authority-bearing acting role and a read does not
an obligation is opened only where the relation creates one, so closing has something real to discharge rather than nothing
obligations and evidence are separate axes and neither is rounded up; an exchange is reported closed only when its obligations are terminal and its required claims presently stand
granting authority is an institutional act and is never implied by asking to enact; without a grant the authorize step refuses and names the role that lacks the permission
discharging an obligation is an act someone performs; recording is never delivery, so enactment does not discharge and closure is unreachable without it

domain evidence may carry a candidate facet and may not carry a compiled contract on its own; a contract asserts a shape for this source rather than for sources like it, and an override is recorded on the binding so the weaker basis stays visible
the phenotype that admitted a relation is resolved the same way everywhere, preferring shape evidence; two answers to which phenotype admitted a facet would make the derivation tier meaningless
a facet defers to the owner of every fact it touches and acquires none of them; it names those owners rather than implying them
only affordances that say what a thing is may derive a phenotype; an affordance describing how a source is reached says nothing about its shape
a facet names the phenotype that admitted it and the tier that evidence came from; a facet that cannot is a domain match wearing a phenotype label
acceptance is every domain the corpus carries, not a favourable specimen per domain; a domain that compiles nothing must be visible in the report rather than omitted from it
this compiler plans observations and never performs one; it says which occurrence is worth a request and ForeignTwin decides robots, retains bytes and writes the receipt
known_gaps: phenotype derivation inherits the precision of the affordance layer beneath it. EVENT reaches only 132 occurrences because the corpus assigns ALERT and REPORT sparsely, which is why the USGS earthquake feed is a DATASET and a SPATIAL_RESOURCE and not an EVENT; hand-correcting that one source would be the `if earthquake then FDSN` failure wearing the opposite coat.
SUPPLY_CHAIN_OBJECT derives from nothing. Its candidate signals were measured as false positives and removed, and no estate role names the shape, so the phenotype is declared and unpopulated.

a facet carries no carrier candidates and no representation requirements. Both fields exist in the contract and the compiler leaves them empty, so a facet says which relation is possible and not yet over what carrier or in which representation.

effect_authorized is an AuthorityGraph grant this estate wrote for itself. Nothing external has delegated any of these permissions, so the rung proves the gate works and not that anyone outside has authorized anything.

the plan orders by candidate facets, which is a measure of what this estate would gain and not of what a source wants. A source that publishes reluctantly and a source that publishes generously sort the same way.

the eleven occurrences this compiler cannot type carry no facets and therefore sort last, which is the wrong end: they are the ones an observation would teach the most about. Ordering cannot fix it, because phenotypes are read from the corpus description rather than from an observed body, so observing them changes nothing until a DomainProfile reads the bytes.
eleven occurrences carry no phenotype at all and stay at depth zero. Their descriptions name a shape this compiler cannot read, which is a fact about those eleven descriptions.

density reads explicit from_owner and to_owner pairs and does not reimplement the participation report's schema-specific normalizer; a receipt that only carries a twin_id contributes no edge here. Two normalizers would be two opinions, so the gap is recorded rather than closed by duplication.

a backend absent from this machine is reported unavailable with its reason, never skipped; a skipped backend leaves the comparison and its absence reads as agreement
a backend that only exercised a job's shape reports no result; an interaction count printed beside a result computed elsewhere measures the runtime and answers nothing
agreement is undetermined rather than assumed when fewer than two backends produced a result
the differential harness is itself tested by corrupting a lowering and requiring the disagreement to surface; an agreement check that cannot fail is decoration
declared availability is a claim about the estate and presence on PATH is a fact about this process, and the two are recorded apart; a vendored but unbuilt runtime is never mistaken for a running one
a lowering states the shape of predicate it can express and refuses input outside it rather than approximating; the boolean encoding refuses a non-boolean field
a mutation test corrupts exactly one reducer, never the shared decode; breaking every backend equally leaves them agreeing and proves nothing
a backend that produced no result carries a reason whatever the reason is; an errored backend rendering as a blank cell is the same silent disappearance the unavailable case was written to prevent
a superposition is binary, so a candidate space is nested, and the index tree and the verdict tree are nested identically; a different shape pairs a candidate with another candidate's answer

a backend answering with an aggregate is checked against the reference's own aggregate and kept out of the set-equality vote; the two are not being asked the same question, and counting them together lets a weaker agreement stand in for a stronger one
a backend states what it answered, so an aggregate is never read as a frontier

the tier asks ResourceAdmission before dispatching to any backend, and a backend admission will not place is refused with that reason recorded; the two were built beside each other and neither consulted the other, so a job declaring money work over institution-private data reached reducers on a machine cleared only for public input
a backend is not placed by default; when the admission decision cannot be obtained, nothing runs rather than everything

a numeric clause compares integers only. A price is carried as micro-USD, because a float disagreeing with the reference in the last bit presents as a backend disagreeing about money and costs more to chase than the scale costs to carry
a backend that cannot express a numeric clause refuses the job rather than dropping the clause; dropping it would leave the backend answering an easier question and calling the result agreement
the survivor set does not depend on the order candidates are presented in; a reducer whose answer moves with the sequence is letting the ranker decide the result

the subset lattice refuses past twenty candidates rather than returning part of it; the collapse emits one line per subset, so this is a wall and not a tuning knob, and a truncated lattice answers a different question while looking like the same one
known_gaps: the lowering expresses boolean predicates only; arithmetic and ordering are not expressible in it, and the operator node form was probed and not established
bend answers an aggregate rather than the frontier, because a fold yields one value; recovering the set through Bend would need a different program and has not been written
hvm4 describes itself as pre-launch, so agreement on one job is evidence for promotion and not promotion; a single cohort is not a differential series

the tier could not be run from a checkout. It reads execution_profile, compute_site and representation_profile rows from the CMS, and none of those three content types existed in the repository -- the schemas lived only on the deploy host. From a clone the tier refuses with "no execution_profile rows are readable", which reads as the backends being missing when what is missing is their declaration. All three are now in version control.

an unrecognised max_data_scope rendered as "cleared for institution_private, this input is public" -- a wider clearance appearing to refuse narrower data, which sends a reader looking for a policy bug. The site had written institution_private where the vocabulary says institution-private, and a typo was being reported as a rule. Fail-closed was right; the message was wrong and now names the unrecognised term.

the lowering is total on booleans. A predicate needing arithmetic or ordering is refused rather than approximated, which is correct and is also the wall between this tier and the financial class of work: money is comparison and summation, so nothing about thresholds, balances or allocations can be expressed here yet.

HVM4 calls itself a sequential Interaction Calculus runtime, so what this tier gets from it is optimal sharing, confluence, and a reducer with no external-call layer -- not parallelism. Reading interaction-net work as "parallel by default" would be the wrong reason to reach for it.

the boolean lowering evaluates the predicate in Python and hands the net the verdicts to fan out. The differential still catches a broken lowering -- corrupting one backend surfaces as disagreement -- but no backend computes what the predicate means, so a predicate that is wrong is wrong identically in all four places. The numeric lowering is the first where the comparison happens in the net.

superposition enumerates the subset lattice; it does not prune it. Measured on real price-book data the cost per branch is roughly constant and mildly improving -- 22.5 interactions per subset at n=4, 17.6 at n=16 -- and the collapse emits one line per branch, so 2^n output. Reading this as a knapsack solver that beats brute force would be laundering: at n=16 the net returned 264 feasible subsets identical to brute force, and it did so by walking all 65,536.

what the net buys here is expression, not complexity: the whole lattice is one declarative term over a fixed operator vocabulary, with no loop and no enumeration written by hand. That is a real property and it is not a speedup.

Bend answers with a sum over candidate indices, which is positional, so its checksum moves when the order moves. That is correct for a positional aggregate and it is a trap: compared against a reference computed in a different order it reads as a backend disagreeing about a pure computation when nothing disagreed.

an address is canonical before it is counted: scheme and host lowercased, a leading www dropped, a default port and tracking parameters removed, one trailing slash dropped, and the address as it was written kept beside it; two inventories listing the same endpoint are one channel

one publisher is one root however many inventories listed it, and every inventory that listed a root or channel keeps its label on it, so the report states roots and channels listed by more than one inventory rather than summing the inventories

a channel's state may rise as the estate learns (shadow, candidate, eligible, waiting_credential, admitted, active) and never falls silently; a refusal is written beside the state so a refused channel stays in the count with its reason
a link found inside a retained body enters as shadow with truth_level observed_link_candidate; it has not been asked for, no robots rule has been checked for it and it is not a source
a catalogue's declared members are virtual channels counted in their own column, so the ledger may hold hundreds of thousands of generated channels without claiming that many active sources
only the census admits: a channel becomes admitted because a published internet_source row reads it, and a census row nothing listed becomes its own channel rather than being lost
one endpoint may be read by several census rows; readers are many-to-many, so three feeds reading one address are three readers of one channel

forbidden_inferences: a read -> a fresh fact; the receipt says when it was read, never that what it says is true
a warm standing -> importance, quality or endorsement of that source
an unspent budget -> the census being fully fresh; the weather's backlog is the measure
invariants: the whole census is considered: rows are allocated for what the census holds, so no row is silently outside the estate's own weather
a source nobody has ever read is the most overdue thing there is, so a newly admitted census row is read on the next tick rather than after its first cadence
a run spends at most its budget, and a publisher's share of one run is the larger of the standing per-host limit and an equal division of the budget among the publishers with something due
a row that is due but unaffordable this run is reported as waiting its turn; the weather states the backlog (due, waiting, never read) rather than implying an empty queue
a source a public surface actually showed in the last three days is warm whatever its authored tier says: demand is read from the source ledger's contribution receipts, not declared
a frozen source is never asked, and a name does not overrule a refusal
the scheduler reads the estate's own foreign root as every other organ does, so pointing an estate at its material cannot leave the scheduler believing nothing was ever read
known_gaps: the budget is a count of sources, not of bytes or seconds; a run of sixty large calendars costs far more than sixty small feeds
demand is measured from what the surfaces showed, not from what anyone read; there is no reader-side signal anywhere in this estate
tiers still move by one notch at a time, so a source that becomes newsworthy warms over several runs rather than at once

forbidden_inferences: a resolved spatial verb -> permission to append, retract, or infer identity or authority from a location
a subject having a coordinate -> that coordinate being disclosable; InformationPolicy still decides per field and per audience
an interpolated or simulated position -> an observation; the mode is carried precisely so the two cannot be read as one
two subjects sharing a coarse cell -> those subjects being near each other; a cell is a narrowing bucket and not a distance
a position being valid -> the subject still being there; valid_until bounds the claim and nothing renews it silently
a spatial relationship -> authority, permission, provider admission or an effect right on either subject
a derived position whose basis was retracted -> a position that still stands; it is reported as an orphaned derivation rather than quietly outliving the fixes that justified it
declared identifier equivalence -> two events being the same physical event; the record is that a source declared these identifiers together at an observed time, and a source can be wrong about that
an owner-transition receipt -> a correct interpretation, an admitted source, or an authorized downstream act; it says an owner accepted a handoff
being within a declared reach -> being visible; no elevation model is held here, so nothing occludes and a frustum answers what lies inside the declared cone rather than what could be seen
a spatial_candidate of bearing -> an observation, a reachable source, or an admitted one; it is what a description said about itself
a spatial_candidate of not_evident -> a source with no coordinates; a listing that said nothing about maps is a listing that said nothing
a durable copy -> a retention decision or an authority to delete the hot store
a receipted body -> a true one; a verified digest says these are the bytes that were observed, not that the source was right or that this estate may repeat what it said
an address -> access; the frontier travels and the population does not, so a shared link grants nothing that the recipient could not have asked for under their own closure
a reconstruction -> a recording; it is recomputed from append-only facts at a stated pair of frontiers and nothing replays a stored frame
internal_calculi: three times, not one: observed_at is when a source saw it, effective_at is when the position is claimed to hold, valid_until is when the claim expires rather than silently persisting as current

two independent time axes: valid time is effective_at..valid_until, when a position holds in the world; knowledge time is recorded_at, when this estate learned it. A reconstruction takes both, and defaults knowledge time to the valid instant so the default question is what was believed then rather than what is believed now about then

the bitemporal cut is: known by the knowledge frontier, not retracted by it, effective by the valid instant, and not expired at it. The expiry clause is kept separate from the others so that never having known and having known something that has since expired remain different answers

retraction appends rather than removes, so a reconstruction as of a knowledge time before the retraction still returns what was retracted; that is what makes an earlier answer reproducible rather than merely remembered

intake is a declared mapping, not a guess: which property carries the subject, which carries the source's own instant, and how that instant is shaped. A feature with no usable source instant is refused and counted rather than stamped with the moment of ingest, because a stamped feature is indistinguishable from a real observation forever afterwards

an ingest is idempotent by the whole source digest. Observing one document twice is one observation of one thing, and a shortened digest would make two documents share a coordinate and silently drop the second one's features

a frontier is addressable: /w/<world>/spatial?at=<instant>&as-of=<instant> carries the pair, plus extent, region, cell and an optional subject of interest. It carries projection coordinates only and never a population, so a recipient recompiles the closure under their own actor and policy and a link cannot hand anyone a subject, a position or a layer they could not have asked for themselves

the world closure runs both stages over one frontier: the plane names which subjects could participate from coarse coordinates alone, and the owner then reconstructs each survivor from its own complete log including facts that were never advertised

coarse addressing narrows and exact geometry answers: spatial/mobility/scale/region/cell/geometry_kind/mode reach the forwarding plane; intersects, within-radius, along-route, nearest-N and visible-from run on the survivors

the closure's cost was never where it looked. A quadratic insertion sort over the survivors made a whole-population query scale with the square of the population -- four times the subjects cost sixteen times the time while four times the bytes cost four -- and replacing it with qsort took twenty thousand subjects from 3.4 s to 0.145 s. Two planner hints were tried first and one of them made things worse; the lesson recorded here is that a set the query depends on is built into a temp table rather than declared as a CTE and hoped for

three indexes carry that: a partial index on retracts, because the retraction check is asked once per candidate row and otherwise falls onto the knowledge index, which at a late frontier matches nearly every fact ever written; an index on observation_id, which both the derivation check and the ingest idempotency guard look up by name; and a partial index over derivations, since only a derivation can be orphaned. The orphan set is built once into a temp table rather than expressed as a correlated check or a CTE, both of which measured slower than the rest of the query combined
invariants: the native Spatial verb is resolved before the store is opened; pure address rendering remains store-free and the six spatial query verbs retain their exact query mode through the shared command descriptor
a world reconstruction binds its exact read-only spatial index path as an ATTACH parameter; punctuation in a filename is not SQL text, a different source, or a writable plane
a feature without a geometry type is refused as invalid geometry before the owner compares or interprets that type
a coordinate is a statement about where an existing subject was observed or projected; it is never a new identity for that subject and a position arriving for an unknown subject creates nothing

observation_mode separates what a source stated from what this estate computed; observed and reported are claims by a source, and propagated, interpolated, inferred and simulated are derivations this estate owns

a display position computed between two fixes is not a third fix; derived positions name the observations they were computed from, so the two stay distinguishable after the fact and not only at the moment of writing
derived spatial state may move as fast as a surface needs; the observations underneath it are append-only and a 12 Hz projection writes no history
geometry, CRS and datum never become forwarding coordinates; a plane carrying geometry starts answering exact spatial questions cheaply and badly

the observation log is append-only and the store enforces it rather than trusting the writer; correcting a fact means appending a retraction, and both the fact and its retraction stay readable afterwards
a position expires rather than silently persisting as current; after valid_until there is no current position, and that is reported as expired and never as the last known place

an extent is never measured as a point; a polygon, line or multi-part shape stores no representative position, and distance is computed against the shape itself, because measuring to a centroid answers how far the middle is while reporting how far the thing is -- wrong by the size of it, and most wrong where it is largest

the maintained live view is derived state and never a second source of truth; a maintained read and a recomputed read must agree, and a disagreement is a defect here rather than a new fact about the world
a retraction is recomputed rather than patched forward; only an append moves the latest fact in one direction, and patching a retraction would leave the view asserting what the log no longer supports
the maintained view stores the latest known fact and never the assertion that it holds now; effectiveness and expiry are decided at read time against the instant actually asked about
a cold representation that cannot be thawed is a deletion with extra steps; the durable tier is verified by content and proved by restoring it
a bounding box exists only to narrow; it is a cheap rejection and never an answer, and no result reports a distance to one
a hole subtracts: a point in the courtyard of a building is not in the building
the occurrence coordinate is the receipt's own and never synthesized; a coordinate nobody else uses is not an identity, and facts carrying one report as depth zero while the chain is in fact running

a subject follows its identifier lineage rather than the latest label a source prefers; a source that changes its preferred identifier while still publishing the previous ones must not split one thing into two subjects
every owner handoff leaves occurrence-keyed evidence; a handoff that leaves none cannot be measured and is indistinguishable from one that never happened
intake produces source claims only; a derivation has to name the facts it came from and a source did not compute one

an estate cannot have learned a position before it was observed; a feature whose source instant is later than the moment of ingest is refused, because storing it produces a log that reconstructs to impossible pasts
a document that failed to parse is a failed observation and never an empty one, because an empty ingest looks exactly like a source that reported nothing
a surviving advertisement names a candidate subject and is never the set of facts about it; reconstructing only from advertised observations would let the forwarding plane decide what is true

parsing an address refuses rather than repairs: a missing frontier, a malformed instant and an undeclared coordinate are all errors, because a half-parsed address shows a reader an instant they did not ask for and does not say so
an exact spatial predicate runs at a reconstruction frontier, so each subject contributes at most the one position it held there; a subject with ten fixes is one thing in a place, not ten
known_gaps: distance is computed in a local tangent plane -- good to well under a metre at this estate's extents and not a geodesic, and it is not the answer to give for a continental span.
area-to-area overlap is answered as closest approach reaching zero rather than as a computed intersection geometry; nothing returns the shape of an overlap.
intake reads a receipt and does not ask for one. ForeignTwin still owns fetching, and nothing schedules re-observation, so a source is placed when someone runs it rather than when the source changes.

the 146 bearing occurrences are classified and not yet observed. Placing any of them still needs a ForeignTwin receipt per source, which is now the only step between the classification and a position.

identifier lineage resolves and never splits. If a source declares two identifiers together and later retracts that association, nothing un-merges the subject; the aliases are time-scoped and the merge is not.

the semantic rung stops at interpreted. No DomainProfile is bound for a seismic event, so nothing reaches profile_bound or carrier_conformant, and the braid cannot grow past this owner on the semantic axis.
temporal_candidate is still the literal "unknown" that spatial_candidate used to be. The same evidence would classify it and nothing has.
intake places GeoJSON points, lines, polygons and their multi-part forms. A GeometryCollection is refused and counted, and no non-GeoJSON encoding is read.

Zarr is deliberately not written. Zarr chunks N-dimensional arrays -- a gridded field sampled over space and time -- and an observation log is not that shape. This owner holds no raster and no continuous surface, so a Zarr tier here would be a container with nothing to put in it; a weather surface or an elevation model would want one, and that is a different record than this.
the durable tier is written and verified and nothing schedules it. Export, verify and thaw are invoked by hand, and no retention policy decides when a hot range becomes cold.

maintenance advances when it is run. Nothing triggers it on append, so a live read is refused until someone runs `maintain`; a Feldera/DBSP dataflow would remove the manual step rather than change the semantics, which are already measured against recomputation.

the served route shows the advertised population and nothing narrower. Publication is the disclosure decision it leans on; InformationPolicy is not consulted per field or per audience, so a World whose published subjects need audience-dependent disclosure is not yet served correctly.

what this estate writes, this estate can read back: the emitter and the reader are exercised against each other on the same awkward bytes rather than each being assumed correct alone
shared HTML text emission writes ordinary spans at once and escapes ampersand, angle brackets, and both quote styles; WebAddress does not emit each ordinary byte through a separate stdio call
known_gaps: four rulesets are declared and the estate has many more shapes. The duplication is closed: 48 C sources and 7 witnesses reach 137 call sites through the one implementation, and the estate's other shared reader, bf_json_str with 47 callers, delegates to it rather than disagreeing with it.

three readers are deliberately not converted. BonfyreAuth's json_field is stricter than the shared one on purpose -- it refuses an unknown escape, a control byte and an empty value, because it is reading a credential rather than a document. BonfyreWebAddress's studio_json_string carries a JSON path and a form-encoded fallback in one function and another agent is working in that file. BonfyreFPQ's legacy_from_10code tree is excluded from the build entirely. All three are named here rather than left unmentioned.
array iteration is not a declared shape. BonfyreGraph walks an array of objects and BonfyreVec scans a list of ids, both by hand, because bf_lex addresses a field and a record and not yet a sequence.

two writers remain and both are deliberate. BonfyreBitNet accumulates into its own buffer rather than writing to a stream, and BonfyreTranscriptClean and BonfyreBrief unescape lossily on purpose -- a transcript wants a newline as a space, not as \n. Neither is the shared shape, and declaring them as one would be the laundering this file exists to prevent.

the rules declare where a field is and the emitters declare how a value is written, and nothing yet declares which documents this estate produces. `check` can say a document carries an undeclared key; it cannot say a binary emitted a document no ruleset describes.
the atlas reports the field keys it stores and never reads and does not refuse them. Refusing would fail CI on 272 lines authors already wrote, so the loss is now visible and still present.

forbidden_inferences: a world -> a subject; it is a publication over one, and an authored world with no subject bound is a magazine about a topic nobody addressed
a world's character -> a claim about the material; an atlas grid does not make the readings authoritative and a flyer wall does not make the night real
