internal_calculi: a world row names its character, its lede, the census sources it composes and the grammars it descends into. The World-fragment authoring compiler lowers each declared grammar into one published presentation-only world_fragment row: it names a SurfaceRenderer family and variant, an extent, a same-origin source projection and an honest cannot_infer, while source bodies remain with the census/ForeignTwin reader. This makes Pixelfed-like vertical movement, stage calendar/timeline, Zulip-like topics, Pinry arrangement, MapLibre spatial composition, commerce availability and Plane-like work density independently addressable expressions of one World rather than branches copied into a page.
invariants: the character is presentation and never a data model; the same reader composes all three, so a fourth character is a stylesheet and a branch, not an application

every World character resolves through a CUE-compiled material renderer descriptor; native emission selects only typed container and item opcodes, while an unrecognized legacy character receives the explicitly authored `default` descriptor rather than a C character-name ladder
a world descends into grammars the estate already serves; the chips resolve through VIEW_ROUTE, and a grammar a world names that no renderer carries is a dead link rather than a new surface
a world fragment changes presentation only; it cannot replace World source selection, parse a source body, identify an actor, admit a provider, disclose a field or authorize an effect

a world composes only sources the census already declared, with the extraction contract the census authored; a world that carries its own scraper has become a second census that can disagree with the first
the primary World document is lowered natively from retained material before send; a browser receives publication-shaped HTML in the World's own character and never a raw census body to interpret

an anonymous World and its shelf may be retained only as a derived response keyed by its public closure and declared owner coordinates; actor, authority, evidence and effect state never enter that cache

when a World renders admitted PublicationOccurrences, its derived public closure registers both the publication family coordinate and each exact occurrence_id alongside the World, WorldFragment, CMS source and ForeignTwin coordinates; a material FactDelta can therefore retire only the World bodies that actually consumed that occurrence

ordinary RSS is accepted only through item/title/link/pubDate extraction; absent author, image, licence, category, actor and effect authority stay absent rather than being inferred from feed markup or a source name
a world is temporary and says so; status is a field, and an ended world stops being published rather than being deleted or quietly left up
the shelf at /w is a list of worlds and never a world; naming nothing returns what is running, which is the only honest thing to show when no subject was asked for

the shelf shows the worlds rather than listing them; each cover is set in the character it opens into, because a rack of identical cards is the catalogue shape this layer exists to replace and would argue the opposite of what is behind each one

a character declares its own palette and faces as roles, so it renders whole with no template at all; a character that stopped declaring them would come out wearing whatever the last template left behind
known_gaps: the world row's subject field is authored empty on all three; the publication reads the census directly and is not yet bound to an addressed subject, so a world cannot be reached from the subject index

RSS promotion now owns reusable PublicationOccurrence rows with source assertion, receipt, rights basis and retention fields. The native World reader still has a retained-body compatibility fallback for a source with no promoted occurrence; that fallback is not reusable material and must not grow into an independent material owner.

a World cache uses exact World/WorldFragment, PublicationOccurrence, CMS source and declared ForeignTwin coordinates, plus a coarse CMS/foreign fingerprint and bounded source-TTL as a delayed-handoff backstop. Independently materialized machine/federation representations still need to join the same closure registry.
